And despite his old age, his owner decides to have him operated on. One of the stables is, as it were, an intensive care department for foals. Students and veterinarians form the foal brigade and are responsible for the animal in need of care 24 hours a day. / Rudy is een bokje met paratuberculose, een ernstige, ongeneeslijke aandoening. De operatie aan haar gebroken poot blijkt een stuk moeilijker dan gedacht. Banier Apache is een hengst van 33 jaar oud. Hij heeft een tumor op zijn penis. programme.title: Emphasis / Klem
programme.desc: Marius and Kitty have been living in Italy for some time, where they managed to lay hands on a vineyard in Tuscany. Marius has improved his life, so Hugo leaves with good courage to drop his daughter Suus with Sophie for a long -awaited reunion with dear friend Chrissie. But there appears to be a breath of fresh air to purchase the vineyard. Hugo has not yet arrived whether everything escalates; Before he knows it, his car is on fire and a fight starts on life and death. Again Hugo is dragged by Kitty and Marius in a criminal vortex, but this time in a country where organized crime does not want Dutch intruders and not scares back for murder and kidnapping. / Marius en Kitty wonen alweer enige tijd in Italië, waar ze de hand hebben weten te leggen op een wijngaard in Toscane. Marius heeft zijn leven gebeterd, dus vertrekt Hugo vol goede moed om samen met Sophie zijn dochter Suus voor een langverwachte reunie bij hartsvriendin Chrissie af te zetten. Maar er blijkt een luchtje te kleven aan de aankoop van de wijngaard. Hugo is nog niet aangekomen of alles escaleert; voor hij het weet vliegt zijn auto in brand en begint er een strijd op leven en dood. Opnieuw wordt Hugo door Kitty en Marius meegesleurd in een criminele draaikolk, maar ditmaal in een land waar de georganiseerde misdaad geen Nederlandse indringers wenst en niet terugschrikt voor moord en ontvoering.

programme.title: A nation witness / Narod priča
programme.desc: The new format, the author's travel-recorted journalist Biljana Stokic, discovery what the heart of the people tells about the Serbian, the tradition and history of our cities and villages, their everyday life and the struggle for preserving true values, diligent work, faith, and love for theirs and ours, Otamb. In a combination of sincere stories of those who live on their work, through the discovery of the sights and natural beauties of our country and their homes, with the words of hope and inspiration, and with pictures of which the heart is melted, with a cheerfulness that defeats all obstacles and problems, Biljana Stokic will peek into their everyday life. How does an ordinary man live? What are his problems and challenges? What is the strength to work and nurture tradition and good interpersonal relationships? How does our native lump breathe and does she have a flat in her beauty? What do they remember? What are they stunned before? What are they coming back? In front of our camera, they will open up and tell the story, who we do not know how much they carry love, research, courage in themselves, those who know how strangely difficult and easy life is, those who have felt the suffering and beauty of life's simplicity. / Novi format, autorska putopisno-reportažna emisija novinarke Biljane Stokić, otkriće vam šta srce naroda priča o Srpskoj, o tradiciji i istoriji naših gradova i sela, o njihovoj svakodnevici i borbi za očuvanje pravih vrijednosti, marljivom radu, vjeri, i ljubavi prema njihovoj i našoj, otadžbini. U spletu iskrenih priča onih koji žive od svog rada, kroz otkrivanje znamenitosti i prirodnih ljepota naše zemlje i njihovih domova, uz riječi nade i inspiracije, te uz slike od kojih se rastopi srce, sa vedrinom koja porazi sve prepreke i probleme, Biljana Stokić će, dugogodišnjim novinarskim iskustvom, zaviriti u njihovu svakodnevicu. Kako živi običan čovjek? Koji su njegovi problemi i izazovi? U čemu nalazi snagu za radom i njegovanje tradicije i dobrih međuljudskih odnosa? Kako diše naša rodna gruda i ima li joj u ljepoti ravne? Čega se sjećaju? Pred čim ostaju zadivljeni? Čemu se vraćaju? Pred našom kamerom, otvoriće se i ispričati priču, oni za koje ne znamo koliko u sebi nose ljubavi, istrajnosti, hrabrosti, oni koji znaju koliko je život čudnovato težak i lak, oni koji su osjetili i stradanje i ljepotu životne jednostavnosti.

programme.title: A world without sand / Svijet bez pijeska
programme.desc: There is a sand we see, which we can smell, the sand we enjoy on vacation, and then there is that invisible sand, one that surrounds us, because sand is a key ingredient of concrete. It builds houses, that is, the whole cities. However, there are fewer and fewer, due to global warming and the growing sea level, but also because of too much exploitation. / Postoji pijesak kojeg vidimo, kojeg možemo pomirisati, pijesak u kojem uživamo na odmoru, a onda je tu onaj nevidljivi pijesak, onaj koji nas okružuje, jer pijesak je ključan sastojak betona. Njime se grade kuće, odnosno čitavi gradovi. Ipak, ima ga sve manje, zbog globalnog zatopljenja i rastuće razine mora, ali i zbog prevelike eksploatacije.

programme.title: From morning to tomorrow / Od jutra do sutra
programme.desc: The series follows the life behind and in front of the camera of your favorite TV steam, Roe deer and Mark. The two of them except the couple are in the studio, they are for years and private life. However, what the audience doesn't even want, is that their idyll on the screen has nothing to do with what the cameras turn off - the two of them actually live a nightmare. When the Marko director of Television is quitting, to move to competing television, he gets a blow from which he falls into a coma, and the director finds a double, young actor Damjan. Damjan will have to play an Oscar brand, and will it work? In addition to being in an interesting way, with many laughs and life situations, their relationship and relationships with colleagues and friends, even to the vortex of the media, will see many secrets, and those business and new love and friendship, and start new avalanches of rivalry. / Serija prati život iza i ispred kamera omiljenog TV para, Srne i Marka. Njih dvoje osim što su par u studiju, oni su to godinama i privatnom životu. Međutim, ono što publika ni ne sluti, jeste da njihova idila na ekranu nema nikakve veze sa onom kad se kamere ugase – njih dvoje zapravo žive noćnu moru. Kada Marko direktoru televizije zatraži otkaz, kako bi prešao na konkurentsku televiziju, dobija udarac od kojeg pada u komu, a direktor pronalazi dvojnika, mladog glumca Damjana. Damjan će morati da odigra Marka za Oskara, a da li će to i uspjeti? Osim što će se na zanimljiv način, sa mnogo smijeha i životnih situacija, usložnjavati njihov odnos i odnos sa kolegama i prijateljima, pa i suparnicima, kroz vrtlog užurbanog života medija, na vidjelo će izaći mnoge tajne, i one poslovne i one privatne, i roditi se neke nove ljubavi i prijateljstva, i pokrenuti nove lavine suparništva.

programme.desc: The new format, the author's travel-recorted journalist Biljana Stokic, discovery what the heart of the people tells about the Serbian, the tradition and history of our cities and villages, their everyday life and the struggle for preserving true values, diligent work, faith, and love for theirs and ours, Otamb. In a combination of sincere stories of those who live on their work, through the discovery of the sights and natural beauties of our country and their homes, with the words of hope and inspiration, and with pictures of which the heart is melted, with a cheerfulness that defeats all obstacles and problems, Biljana Stokic will peek into their everyday life. How does an ordinary man live? What are his problems and challenges? What is the strength to work and nurture tradition and good interpersonal relationships? How does our native lump breathe and does she have a flat in her beauty? What do they remember? What are they stunned before? What are they coming back? In front of our camera, they will open up and tell the story, who we do not know how much they carry love, research, courage in themselves, those who know how strangely difficult and easy life is, those who have felt the suffering and beauty of life's simplicity. / Novi format, autorska putopisno-reportažna emisija novinarke Biljane Stokić, otkriće vam šta srce naroda priča o Srpskoj, o tradiciji i istoriji naših gradova i sela, o njihovoj svakodnevici i borbi za očuvanje pravih vrijednosti, marljivom radu, vjeri, i ljubavi prema njihovoj i našoj, otadžbini. U spletu iskrenih priča onih koji žive od svog rada, kroz otkrivanje znamenitosti i prirodnih ljepota naše zemlje i njihovih domova, uz riječi nade i inspiracije, te uz slike od kojih se rastopi srce, sa vedrinom koja porazi sve prepreke i probleme, Biljana Stokić će, dugogodišnjim novinarskim iskustvom, zaviriti u njihovu svakodnevicu. Kako živi običan čovjek? Koji su njegovi problemi i izazovi? U čemu nalazi snagu za radom i njegovanje tradicije i dobrih međuljudskih odnosa? Kako diše naša rodna gruda i ima li joj u ljepoti ravne? programme.title: Then and now / Tada And Sada
programme.desc: The series includes the late 1940s, the end of the Second World War, the beginning of the wars in Yugoslavia .. From the time of the Socialist Federal Republic of Yugoslavia (SFRY) in the 1980s, the rise of the Yugoslavia, to the conflict that lasted more than a decade. The series is now compared and then through various topics, including living standards, political system, human rights, religious rights, national recognition, media freedom, freedom of citizens. They face both sides, the one who continues to say that in the past was better for us, and the one that supports the present as better. The series opens a debate on whether the advocates for "then" is too romantically blinded by the past and too pessimistic about the current situation, and vice versa, whether they are for "now" too harsh by the past and the then system. / Serija obuhvata ​​period kasnih 1940-ih, kraj Drugog svjetskog rata do početka devedesetih, početak ratova u Jugoslaviji.. od vremena Socijalistička Federativne Republike Jugoslavije (SFRJ), preko ekonomske i političke krize 1980-ih godina, porasta nacionalizma, raspada Jugoslavije, pa do konflikta koji je trajao više od jedne decenije. Serija upoređuje Sada i Tada kroz različite teme, uključujući životni standard, politički sistem, ljudska prava, vjerska prava, nacionalno priznanje, slobodu medija, slobodu građana. Suočavaju se obje strane, ona koja nastavlja da govori da nam je u prošlosti bilo bolje, i ona koja podržava sadašnjost kao bolje. Serija otvara debatu o tome da li su zagovornici za "Tada" previše romantično zaslijepljeni prošlošću i previše pesimistični o sadašnjoj situaciji, i obrnuto, da li su oni za "Sada" suviše oštri prema prošlosti i tadašnjem sistemu.

programme.title: Pope, the most powerful man in history / Papa, najmoćniji čovjek u historiji
programme.desc: The six -part documentary series exploring the history of the cult, globally significant role of the Pope, one of the most respected and most beloved figures. Despite the constantly changing world, Catholics viewed the pope as a lighthouse of faith, morality and divine leadership. The story of a apostle on the started trip, culminating in a global figure over a community with more than 1.2 billion followers. Each of the six episodes examines a key historical moment, in the changing dynamics of this extremely strong role and explores that the Pope and the Church have occupied the position they have today. One world leader .. with military, political and religious power remains wrapped in a veil of secrets, despite the unimaginable influence through the history and use of his power to design the flow of world history. Thanks to the approach to Vatican archives and exclusive interviews with some of the most prominent religious leaders and theologians, the series explores that the 12 apostles grew into today's 1.2 billion Catholics. / Šestodijelni dokumentarni serijal koji istražuje historiju kultne, globalno značajne uloge pape, jednog od najcjenjenijih i najomiljenijih figura. Uprkos svijetu koji se stalno mijenja, katolici su na papu gledali kao na svjetionika vjere, morala i božansko vodstvo. Priča o jednom apostolu na započetom putovanju, koje je kulminiralo globalnom figurom nad zajednicom s više od 1,2 milijardu sljedbenika. Svaka od šest epizoda ispituje ključni historijski trenutak, u promjenjivoj dinamici ove iznimno snažne uloge i istražuje kako su papa i crkva zauzeli položaj koji danas imaju. Jedan svjetski vođa.. s vojnom, političkom i vjerskom moći ostaje obavijen velom tajne, uprkos nezamislivom utjecaju kroz historiju i korištenju svoje moći da bi oblikovao tok svjetske historije. Zahvaljujući pristupu vatikanskim arhivima i ekskluzivnim intervjuima s nekima od najistaknutijih vjerskih vođa i teologa, serija istražuje kako je 12 apostola preraslo u današnjih 1,2 milijarde katolika.

programme.title: The game of fate / Igra sudbine
programme.desc: The Sultan wants to find out the story of Alis, daughter Madam Anet, and find out if they really have so many similarities. Međutim, Feride će sve u firmi iznenaditi svojim katalogom kojem je dala ime Feniks. Zbog toga što ga ponovo ucjenjuje, Tahsin prepušta Keremu vilu u kojoj živi njegova porodica, ali ga moli da ništa ne govori Perihan. Aziz je zbunjen kada vidi Feride sa Jalčinom, ali i kada shvati da je sat koji je ispao Feride, zapravo pripadao njegovom djedu...Uloge: Kadir Doğulu, Devrim Özkan, Ümit Kantarcılar, Onur Seyit Yaran, Gozde Kaya, Pelin Uluksar, Mehmet OzgurRežija: Murat Onbul

Cultural and historical heritage, unknown stories and details from our heritage, but also a reminder of valuable cultural treasure that preserve museums across the country. The stories are processed only by basic and most interesting details, with the aim of encouraging viewers to visit museums and institutions in which exhibits are found. In the fundus you will see the interesting facts you haven't known so far, the items you haven't seen before, and it will also present part of the tradition on which there is no information recorded. / "Fundus" je format TV priča čije su teme bh. kulturno-historijsko naslijeđe, nepoznate priče i detalji iz naše baštine, ali i podsjećanje na vrijedno kulturno blago koje čuvaju muzeji širom zemlje. programme.title: Then and now / Tada And Sada
programme.desc: The series includes the late 1940s, the end of the Second World War, the beginning of the wars in Yugoslavia .. From the time of the Socialist Federal Republic of Yugoslavia (SFRY) in the 1980s, the rise of the Yugoslavia, to the conflict that lasted more than a decade. The series is now compared and then through various topics, including living standards, political system, human rights, religious rights, national recognition, media freedom, freedom of citizens. They face both sides, the one who continues to say that in the past was better for us, and the one that supports the present as better. The series opens a debate on whether the advocates for "then" is too romantically blinded by the past and too pessimistic about the current situation, and vice versa, whether they are for "now" too harsh by the past and the then system. / Serija obuhvata ​​period kasnih 1940-ih, kraj Drugog svjetskog rata do početka devedesetih, početak ratova u Jugoslaviji.. od vremena Socijalistička Federativne Republike Jugoslavije (SFRJ), preko ekonomske i političke krize 1980-ih godina, porasta nacionalizma, raspada Jugoslavije, pa do konflikta koji je trajao više od jedne decenije. Serija upoređuje Sada i Tada kroz različite teme, uključujući životni standard, politički sistem, ljudska prava, vjerska prava, nacionalno priznanje, slobodu medija, slobodu građana. Suočavaju se obje strane, ona koja nastavlja da govori da nam je u prošlosti bilo bolje, i ona koja podržava sadašnjost kao bolje. Serija otvara debatu o tome da li su zagovornici za "Tada" previše romantično zaslijepljeni prošlošću i previše pesimistični o sadašnjoj situaciji, i obrnuto, da li su oni za "Sada" suviše oštri prema prošlosti i tadašnjem sistemu.

programme.title: Pope, the most powerful man in history / Papa, najmoćniji čovjek u historiji
programme.desc: The six -part documentary series exploring the history of the cult, globally significant role of the Pope, one of the most respected and most beloved figures. Despite the constantly changing world, Catholics viewed the pope as a lighthouse of faith, morality and divine leadership. The story of a apostle on the started trip, culminating in a global figure over a community with more than 1.2 billion followers. Each of the six episodes examines a key historical moment, in the changing dynamics of this extremely strong role and explores that the Pope and the Church have occupied the position they have today. One world leader .. with military, political and religious power remains wrapped in a veil of secrets, despite the unimaginable influence through the history and use of his power to design the flow of world history. Thanks to the approach to Vatican archives and exclusive interviews with some of the most prominent religious leaders and theologians, the series explores that the 12 apostles grew into today's 1.2 billion Catholics. / Šestodijelni dokumentarni serijal koji istražuje historiju kultne, globalno značajne uloge pape, jednog od najcjenjenijih i najomiljenijih figura. Uprkos svijetu koji se stalno mijenja, katolici su na papu gledali kao na svjetionika vjere, morala i božansko vodstvo. Priča o jednom apostolu na započetom putovanju, koje je kulminiralo globalnom figurom nad zajednicom s više od 1,2 milijardu sljedbenika. Svaka od šest epizoda ispituje ključni historijski trenutak, u promjenjivoj dinamici ove iznimno snažne uloge i istražuje kako su papa i crkva zauzeli položaj koji danas imaju. Jedan svjetski vođa.. s vojnom, političkom i vjerskom moći ostaje obavijen velom tajne, uprkos nezamislivom utjecaju kroz historiju i korištenju svoje moći da bi oblikovao tok svjetske historije. Zahvaljujući pristupu vatikanskim arhivima i ekskluzivnim intervjuima s nekima od najistaknutijih vjerskih vođa i teologa, serija istražuje kako je 12 apostola preraslo u današnjih 1,2 milijarde katolika.

programme.desc: "Fundus" is a TV story format whose themes are BH. Cultural and historical heritage, unknown stories and details from our heritage, but also a reminder of valuable cultural treasure that preserve museums across the country. The best promotion of the state is through its rich and varied culture. Museum depots keep thousands of valuable cases and exhibits, including numerous world rarities. Priče obrađuju samo osnovne i najzanimljivije detalje, s ciljem da potaknu gledatelje da za više informacija posjete muzeje i ustanove u kojima se nalaze eksponati. Ludilo se širi, a ljudi se nadaju da ono neće stići do miroljubivog Novog Sada i da Evropa i svijet neće dozvoliti širenje nacizma te ne preduzimaju ništa, iako im sve govori da treba bježati i spašavati se. Sigurni su da razum uvijek na kraju nadvlada. Glavna junakinja je Vera Kroner, djevojka iz bogate trgovačke jevrejske porodice, koja iz gospodskog novosadskog života biva deportovana u Aušvic 1943. sa svojom porodicom ali i sa ostalim jevrejskim porodicama. Vera jedina preživljava taj stravičan život i prizore, jer logorsko vrijeme provodi u "kući radosti", bordelu koji produžava život i odlaže odlazak u krematorij. Pitanje je da li treba preživjeti kada se cijeli tvoj svijet raspadne i nestane? Nije li bolje, časnije i pametnije nestati zajedno sa njim? Da li se treba boriti za život ako poslije toga slijede traume i slike najgorih užasa, koje se vraćaju i ne daju mira. A kako se ne boriti za život kada je to najjači čovjekov nagon? Kako mu objasniti da ne treba živjeti? Čovjeka mijenjaju okolnosti. Prilagođava se. Postaje ono što vrijeme traži od njega... U predstavi igraju: Emina Elor, Jugoslav Krajnov, Predrag Marjanović, Draginja Voganjac, Aljoša Điđić, Danilo Milanović, Dušan Vukašinović.

programme.desc: The mysteries of Dr. Blake (The Doctor: The Doctor Blake Mysteries) is an Australian television series first aired on ABC on February 1, 2013 at 8:30 pm [1]. Creg Dugal McLlan is in the role of Dr. Lucien Blake, who returned to Balarat, northwest of Melbourne, in the late 1950s, to take over the general medical practice of his late father and the role of a police surgeon after 30 years. Five seasons have been broadcast until 2017, after which the program is closed at the end of the fifth season. The first two seasons have 10 episodes while the next ones have 8 each. Each episode is about an hour - between 56 and 59 minutes. / Мистериите на доктор Блейк (на английски: The Doctor Blake Mysteries) е австралийски телевизионен сериал, излъчен за първи път по ABC на 1 февруари 2013 г. в 20:30 часа[1]. Крег Дугъл Маклалън е в ролята на доктор Лусиен Блейк, който се завръща в Баларат, северозападно от Мелбърн, в края на 1950-те години, за да поеме общата медицинска практика на покойния си баща и ролята на полицейски хирург след отсъствие от 30 години. Пет сезона се излъчват до 2017 г., след което програмата е закрита в края на петия сезон. Първите два сезона имат 10 епизода докато следващите имат по 8. Всеки епизод е около час – между 56 и 59 минути.

Gardener / Vrtlarica
programme.desc: Gardener - (S05, E12, Nature. Film, Croatia, 2024) The new season of gardeners brings a number of inspirational solutions for different situations and problems related to organic growing vegetables and fruits. There are many challenges, especially those related to climate change. In unpredictable intervals alternate floods, hail and dry periods, which directly affects the established rhythm of the gardening season. It's time for change, but also for accepting responsibility for nature that needs our help. We will find out how to influence biodiversity in our own garden, how to preserve autochthonous types of plants from the surrounding area, but also get to know some exotic types of vegetables and fruits. But with an abundance of gardening tips, the gardener also takes us on our way. We will get to know the beautiful contemporary gardens and biological lakes and learn how to relax after working in the garden with the beauty of nature. R.: Nino Šoštarić ... / Vrtlarica - (S05, E12, prirod. film, Hrvatska, 2024) Nova sezona Vrtlarice donosi niz inspirativnih rješenja za različite situacije i probleme vezane uz organski uzgoj povrća I voća. Izazova je mnogo, posebno onih vezanih uz klimatske promjene. U nepredvidljivim intervalima izmjenjuju se poplave, tuča i sušna razdoblja, što izravno utječe na ustaljeni ritam vrtlarske sezone. Vrijeme je za promjene, ali i za prihvaćanje odgovornosti za prirodu koja treba našu pomoć. Doznat ćemo kako utjecati na bioraznolikost u vlastitom vrtu, kako sačuvati autohtone vrste biljaka iz okolice, ali i upoznati neke egzotične vrste povrća i voća. No uz obilje vrtlarskih savjeta, Vrtlarica nas vodi i na put. Upoznat ćemo prekrasne suvremene vrtove i biološka jezera te naučiti kako se nakon rada u vrtu opustiti uz ljepotu prirode. R.: Nino Šoštarić...

programme.title: David Skoko: engine, vine, cooker / David Skoko: Motor, loza, kuhača
programme.desc: David Skoko: Motor, Loza, Cook - (E04, Educational Program, Croatia, 2023) David Skoko takes us to Istria to visit Ivan Damjanic, a Poreč winemaker whose ancestors in 1928 had a gold medal from the international wine competition in Paris on the wall. In his twenties, John sold the engine to buy a tractor and plant a vineyard. Soon he became one of the Istrian wine stars from the unknown Poreč winemaker. David's fish menu in this episode also includes less known sea specialties such as Butarge. programme.title: The promise / La Promesa
programme.desc: La Proses - (S04, E10, featured series, Spain, 2024) In 1913, while Europe is ruled by unrest, life on the noble estate of LA Provece owned by the Luján family can not be calmer - at least it seems. The family is preparing to celebrate one of the most important events in Spanish surplus society - the wedding of Tomás, the eldest son of Count Luján and the daughter of one of the most comfortable families in the country. However, the Luján family knows that this is a contracted marriage that the family should save from financial ruin. In the meantime, the enigmatic young Jana (20) begins to work on LA Promethew and helps as a maid during preparation for a wedding. As he wanders the building, he meets Manuel (23) the Counts of the youngest son and Tomás's half -brother. It is a meeting that will not be able to forget ... The Countess on the day of the wedding cannot hide her dissatisfaction since she wanted the groom to actually be her son Manuel. Her dissatisfaction is growing increasing, and after her outburst of anger, Jana gets fired. During the wedding, everything goes according to plan until Manuel performs a play with his plane double and shows incredible acrobatic skills, and the celebration is interrupted when he loses control and collapses not far from the property. Jana saw what happened and hurried to the scene to save Manuel. The Count offered Jani a generous award in gratitude, but she only asked to return her to work. The family does not know this, but Jana has a plan to avenge her mother who happened 15 years ago and wants to find her younger brother, who has been abducted the same evening. The only trail that Jana has to lead is to the magnificent building of La Provece, which he wants to infiltrate and find a murderer ... but also find love in Manuel's embrace. The next day another unfortunate event brings confusion to the property. Tomás was found dead. Sergeant Conrado, a member of the Civil Guard, is determined in his plan to find the killer. All evidence is referred to Jan because she is the last person with whom Tomás talked before his death. R .: Miguel Conda ... / La promesa - (S04, E10, igrana serija, Španjolska, 2024) Godine 1913., dok Europom vladaju nemiri, život na plemićkom imanju La Promesa u vlasništvu obitelji Luján ne može biti mirniji - bar se tako čini. Obitelj se priprema za proslavu jednog od najvažnijih događaja u španjolskom viskom društvu - vjenčanje Tomása, najstarijeg sina grofa Lujána i kćeri jedne od najimućnijih obitelji u zemlji. Međutim, obitelj Luján zna kako je ovo ugovoreni brak koji bi obitelj trebao spasiti od financijske propasti. U međuvremenu, zagonetna mlada Jana (20) počinje raditi na La Promesi te kao sluškinja pomaže tijekom priprema za vjenčanje. Dok luta zdanjem, susreće Manuela (23) grofova najmlađeg sina i Tomásova polubrata. Susret je to koji neće moći zaboraviti... Grofica na dan vjenčanja ne može skriti svoje nezadovoljstvo budući da je ona htjela da mladoženja zapravo bude njezin sin Manuel. Njezino nezadovoljstvo sve više raste, a nakon njezina ispada bijesa, Jana dobiva otkaz. Tijekom vjenčanja sve ide po planu sve dok Manuel ne izvede predstavu sa svojim avionom dvokrilcem te pokaže nevjerojatne akrobatske vještine, a slavlje se prekida kad izgubi kontrolu i sruši se nedaleko od imanja. Jana je vidjela što se dogodilo te pohita na mjesto nesreće kako bi spasila Manuela. Grof ponudi Jani velikodušnu nagradu u znak zahvalnosti, ali ona zatraži samo da je vrate na posao. Obitelj to ne zna, ali Jana cijelo vrijeme ima plan osvetiti ubojstvo svoje majke koje se dogodilo prije 15 godina te želi pronaći svog mlađeg brata koji je iste večeri otet. Jedini trag koji Jana ima vodi je do velebnog zdanja La Promesa u koje se želi infiltrirati te pronaći ubojicu... Ali i naći ljubav u Manuelovom zagrljaju. Idućeg dana još jedan nesretni događaj unese pomutnju na imanje. Tomás je pronađen mrtav. Narednik Conrado, pripadnik civilne garde, odlučan je u svom naumu da pronađe ubojicu. Svi dokazi upućuju na Janu jer ona je posljednja osoba s kojom je Tomás prije smrti razgovarao. R.: Miguel Cond...

programme.title: The famous sights / Slavne znamenitosti
programme.desc: Iconic Landmarks - (E06, Educational Program, France) with its huge 175 meters long hall, Orsay is home to the largest collection of impressionistic art in the world. This stone and steel building opened on December 1, 1986, officially opened by François Mitterrand, has been carrying the title of historic monument since 1978. Repeatedly destined for demolition, the Orsay Station building was the subject of many discussions before it was finally turned into a museum, a link that was missing between Louvre and the Pumpidou Center. From that moment on, this building constantly feeds the imagination of architects. Going through the project for the project, the Orsay Museum gradually grew and increased its splendor to attract more and more visitors. Discover what challenges have been encountered by architects and workers with all new changes in order to modernize the building with the preservation of its historical features. R.: Blandine Josselin ... / Iconic landmarks - (E06, obrazovni program, Francuska) Sa svojom golemom dvoranom dugom 175 metara, Orsay je dom najveće zbirke impresionističke umjetnosti na svijetu. Ta zgrada od kamena i čelika koju je 1. prosinca 1986. svečano otvorio François Mitterrand, od 1978. godine nosi titulu povijesnog spomenika. Više puta predodređena za rušenje, zgrada kolodvora Orsay bila je predmetom mnogih rasprava prije nego što je napokon pretvorena u muzej, kariku koja je nedostajala između Louvrea i Centra Pompidou. Od tog trenutka ova građevina neprestano hrani maštu arhitekata. Prolazeći kroz projekt za projektom, Muzej Orsay je postupno rastao i povećavao svoj sjaj kako bi privukao sve više posjetitelja. Otkrijte na kakve su sve izazove nailazili arhitekti i radnici pri svim novim izmjenama kako bi se građevina modernizirala uz očuvanje njezinih povijesnih obilježja. R.: Blandine Josselin...

programme.title: The promise / La Promesa
programme.desc: La Proses - (S04, E10, featured series, Spain, 2024) In 1913, while Europe is ruled by unrest, life on the noble estate of LA Provece owned by the Luján family can not be calmer - at least it seems. The family is preparing to celebrate one of the most important events in Spanish surplus society - the wedding of Tomás, the eldest son of Count Luján and the daughter of one of the most comfortable families in the country. However, the Luján family knows that this is a contracted marriage that the family should save from financial ruin. In the meantime, the enigmatic young Jana (20) begins to work on LA Promethew and helps as a maid during preparation for a wedding. As he wanders the building, he meets Manuel (23) the Counts of the youngest son and Tomás's half -brother. It is a meeting that will not be able to forget ... The Countess on the day of the wedding cannot hide her dissatisfaction since she wanted the groom to actually be her son Manuel. Her dissatisfaction is growing increasing, and after her outburst of anger, Jana gets fired. During the wedding, everything goes according to plan until Manuel performs a play with his plane double and shows incredible acrobatic skills, and the celebration is interrupted when he loses control and collapses not far from the property. Jana saw what happened and hurried to the scene to save Manuel. The Count offered Jani a generous award in gratitude, but she only asked to return her to work. The family does not know this, but Jana has a plan to avenge her mother who happened 15 years ago and wants to find her younger brother, who has been abducted the same evening. The only trail that Jana has to lead is to the magnificent building of La Provece, which he wants to infiltrate and find a murderer ... but also find love in Manuel's embrace. The next day another unfortunate event brings confusion to the property. Tomás was found dead. Sergeant Conrado, a member of the Civil Guard, is determined in his plan to find the killer. All evidence is referred to Jan because she is the last person with whom Tomás talked before his death. R .: Miguel Conda ... / La promesa - (S04, E10, igrana serija, Španjolska, 2024) Godine 1913., dok Europom vladaju nemiri, život na plemićkom imanju La Promesa u vlasništvu obitelji Luján ne može biti mirniji - bar se tako čini. Obitelj se priprema za proslavu jednog od najvažnijih događaja u španjolskom viskom društvu - vjenčanje Tomása, najstarijeg sina grofa Lujána i kćeri jedne od najimućnijih obitelji u zemlji. Međutim, obitelj Luján zna kako je ovo ugovoreni brak koji bi obitelj trebao spasiti od financijske propasti. U međuvremenu, zagonetna mlada Jana (20) počinje raditi na La Promesi te kao sluškinja pomaže tijekom priprema za vjenčanje. Dok luta zdanjem, susreće Manuela (23) grofova najmlađeg sina i Tomásova polubrata. Susret je to koji neće moći zaboraviti... Grofica na dan vjenčanja ne može skriti svoje nezadovoljstvo budući da je ona htjela da mladoženja zapravo bude njezin sin Manuel. Njezino nezadovoljstvo sve više raste, a nakon njezina ispada bijesa, Jana dobiva otkaz. Tijekom vjenčanja sve ide po planu sve dok Manuel ne izvede predstavu sa svojim avionom dvokrilcem te pokaže nevjerojatne akrobatske vještine, a slavlje se prekida kad izgubi kontrolu i sruši se nedaleko od imanja. Jana je vidjela što se dogodilo te pohita na mjesto nesreće kako bi spasila Manuela. Grof ponudi Jani velikodušnu nagradu u znak zahvalnosti, ali ona zatraži samo da je vrate na posao. Obitelj to ne zna, ali Jana cijelo vrijeme ima plan osvetiti ubojstvo svoje majke koje se dogodilo prije 15 godina te želi pronaći svog mlađeg brata koji je iste večeri otet. Jedini trag koji Jana ima vodi je do velebnog zdanja La Promesa u koje se želi infiltrirati te pronaći ubojicu... Ali i naći ljubav u Manuelovom zagrljaju. Idućeg dana još jedan nesretni događaj unese pomutnju na imanje. Tomás je pronađen mrtav. Narednik Conrado, pripadnik civilne garde, odlučan je u svom naumu da pronađe ubojicu. Svi dokazi upućuju na Janu jer ona je posljednja osoba s kojom je Tomás prije smrti razgovarao. R.: Miguel Cond...

programme.desc: Gardener - (S04, E01, Nature. Film, Croatia, 2022) The fourth season of gardeners brings a kind of walk through the gardening year, for the first time we can follow from the episode in the episode as Cornelia's garden changes from spring to the end of the gardening season. We discover all the details and small secrets of successful organic growing of vegetables and fruits in the now altered climates. We will find out how to maximize the warmth of early spring for the growing of early vegetables to provide culture shift in mid-summer and a new cycle of summer-human vegetables. In this way, the ideal of self -sufficiency of the family garden is no longer a utopia, but a realistic possibility that anyone who has the courage can get their hands and take some time for gardening. With the simple instructions that accompany the organic breeding of plants, enjoy 12 episodes of this season, which we believe, will also include those who have not yet ventured into the magical world of plants. ------ the beginning of spring in the garden. The billets are empty and should be prepared for new plants. Because the soil is still wet and cold, we only plant those species that can handle spring freshness. For all the rest of the time it is yet to come, so we sow and transplant them in the heat of the greenhouse. R.: Nino Šoštarić ... / Vrtlarica - (S04, E01, prirod. film, Hrvatska, 2022) Četvrta sezona Vrtlarice donosi svojevrsni hod kroz vrtlarsku godinu, prvi put možemo iz epizode u epizodu pratiti kako se Kornelijin vrt mijenja od proljeća pa sve do kraja vrtlarske sezone. programme.title: The promise / La Promesa
programme.desc: La Proses - (S04, E11, feature series, Spain, 2024) In 1913, while Europe is ruled by unrest, life on the noble estate of LA Provece owned by the Luján family can not be calmer - at least it seems. The family is preparing to celebrate one of the most important events in Spanish surplus society - the wedding of Tomás, the eldest son of Count Luján and the daughter of one of the most comfortable families in the country. However, the Luján family knows that this is a contracted marriage that the family should save from financial ruin. In the meantime, the enigmatic young Jana (20) begins to work on LA Promethew and helps as a maid during preparation for a wedding. As he wanders the building, he meets Manuel (23) the Counts of the youngest son and Tomás's half -brother. It is a meeting that will not be able to forget ... The Countess on the day of the wedding cannot hide her dissatisfaction since she wanted the groom to actually be her son Manuel. Her dissatisfaction is growing increasing, and after her outburst of anger, Jana gets fired. During the wedding, everything goes according to plan until Manuel performs a play with his plane double and shows incredible acrobatic skills, and the celebration is interrupted when he loses control and collapses not far from the property. Jana saw what happened and hurried to the scene to save Manuel. The Count offered Jani a generous award in gratitude, but she only asked to return her to work. The family does not know this, but Jana has a plan to avenge her mother who happened 15 years ago and wants to find her younger brother, who has been abducted the same evening. The only trail that Jana has to lead is to the magnificent building of La Provece, which he wants to infiltrate and find a murderer ... but also find love in Manuel's embrace. The next day another unfortunate event brings confusion to the property. Tomás was found dead. Sergeant Conrado, a member of the Civil Guard, is determined in his plan to find the killer. All evidence is referred to Jan because she is the last person with whom Tomás talked before his death. R .: Miguel Conda ... / La promesa - (S04, E11, igrana serija, Španjolska, 2024) Godine 1913., dok Europom vladaju nemiri, život na plemićkom imanju La Promesa u vlasništvu obitelji Luján ne može biti mirniji - bar se tako čini. Obitelj se priprema za proslavu jednog od najvažnijih događaja u španjolskom viskom društvu - vjenčanje Tomása, najstarijeg sina grofa Lujána i kćeri jedne od najimućnijih obitelji u zemlji. Međutim, obitelj Luján zna kako je ovo ugovoreni brak koji bi obitelj trebao spasiti od financijske propasti. U međuvremenu, zagonetna mlada Jana (20) počinje raditi na La Promesi te kao sluškinja pomaže tijekom priprema za vjenčanje. Dok luta zdanjem, susreće Manuela (23) grofova najmlađeg sina i Tomásova polubrata. Susret je to koji neće moći zaboraviti... Grofica na dan vjenčanja ne može skriti svoje nezadovoljstvo budući da je ona htjela da mladoženja zapravo bude njezin sin Manuel. Njezino nezadovoljstvo sve više raste, a nakon njezina ispada bijesa, Jana dobiva otkaz. Tijekom vjenčanja sve ide po planu sve dok Manuel ne izvede predstavu sa svojim avionom dvokrilcem te pokaže nevjerojatne akrobatske vještine, a slavlje se prekida kad izgubi kontrolu i sruši se nedaleko od imanja. Jana je vidjela što se dogodilo te pohita na mjesto nesreće kako bi spasila Manuela. Grof ponudi Jani velikodušnu nagradu u znak zahvalnosti, ali ona zatraži samo da je vrate na posao. Obitelj to ne zna, ali Jana cijelo vrijeme ima plan osvetiti ubojstvo svoje majke koje se dogodilo prije 15 godina te želi pronaći svog mlađeg brata koji je iste večeri otet. Jedini trag koji Jana ima vodi je do velebnog zdanja La Promesa u koje se želi infiltrirati te pronaći ubojicu... Ali i naći ljubav u Manuelovom zagrljaju. Idućeg dana još jedan nesretni događaj unese pomutnju na imanje. Tomás je pronađen mrtav. Narednik Conrado, pripadnik civilne garde, odlučan je u svom naumu da pronađe ubojicu. Svi dokazi upućuju na Janu jer ona je posljednja osoba s kojom je Tomás prije smrti razgovarao. R.: Miguel Cond...

programme.title: The promise / La Promesa
programme.desc: La Proses - (S04, E11, feature series, Spain, 2024) In 1913, while Europe is ruled by unrest, life on the noble estate of LA Provece owned by the Luján family can not be calmer - at least it seems. The family is preparing to celebrate one of the most important events in Spanish surplus society - the wedding of Tomás, the eldest son of Count Luján and the daughter of one of the most comfortable families in the country. However, the Luján family knows that this is a contracted marriage that the family should save from financial ruin. In the meantime, the enigmatic young Jana (20) begins to work on LA Promethew and helps as a maid during preparation for a wedding. As he wanders the building, he meets Manuel (23) the Counts of the youngest son and Tomás's half -brother. It is a meeting that will not be able to forget ... The Countess on the day of the wedding cannot hide her dissatisfaction since she wanted the groom to actually be her son Manuel. Her dissatisfaction is growing increasing, and after her outburst of anger, Jana gets fired. During the wedding, everything goes according to plan until Manuel performs a play with his plane double and shows incredible acrobatic skills, and the celebration is interrupted when he loses control and collapses not far from the property. Jana saw what happened and hurried to the scene to save Manuel. The Count offered Jani a generous award in gratitude, but she only asked to return her to work. The family does not know this, but Jana has a plan to avenge her mother who happened 15 years ago and wants to find her younger brother, who has been abducted the same evening. The only trail that Jana has to lead is to the magnificent building of La Provece, which he wants to infiltrate and find a murderer ... but also find love in Manuel's embrace. The next day another unfortunate event brings confusion to the property. Tomás was found dead. Sergeant Conrado, a member of the Civil Guard, is determined in his plan to find the killer. All evidence is referred to Jan because she is the last person with whom Tomás talked before his death. R .: Miguel Conda ... / La promesa - (S04, E11, igrana serija, Španjolska, 2024) Godine 1913., dok Europom vladaju nemiri, život na plemićkom imanju La Promesa u vlasništvu obitelji Luján ne može biti mirniji - bar se tako čini. Obitelj se priprema za proslavu jednog od najvažnijih događaja u španjolskom viskom društvu - vjenčanje Tomása, najstarijeg sina grofa Lujána i kćeri jedne od najimućnijih obitelji u zemlji. Međutim, obitelj Luján zna kako je ovo ugovoreni brak koji bi obitelj trebao spasiti od financijske propasti. U međuvremenu, zagonetna mlada Jana (20) počinje raditi na La Promesi te kao sluškinja pomaže tijekom priprema za vjenčanje. Dok luta zdanjem, susreće Manuela (23) grofova najmlađeg sina i Tomásova polubrata. Susret je to koji neće moći zaboraviti... Grofica na dan vjenčanja ne može skriti svoje nezadovoljstvo budući da je ona htjela da mladoženja zapravo bude njezin sin Manuel. Njezino nezadovoljstvo sve više raste, a nakon njezina ispada bijesa, Jana dobiva otkaz. Tijekom vjenčanja sve ide po planu sve dok Manuel ne izvede predstavu sa svojim avionom dvokrilcem te pokaže nevjerojatne akrobatske vještine, a slavlje se prekida kad izgubi kontrolu i sruši se nedaleko od imanja. Jana je vidjela što se dogodilo te pohita na mjesto nesreće kako bi spasila Manuela. Grof ponudi Jani velikodušnu nagradu u znak zahvalnosti, ali ona zatraži samo da je vrate na posao. Obitelj to ne zna, ali Jana cijelo vrijeme ima plan osvetiti ubojstvo svoje majke koje se dogodilo prije 15 godina te želi pronaći svog mlađeg brata koji je iste večeri otet. Jedini trag koji Jana ima vodi je do velebnog zdanja La Promesa u koje se želi infiltrirati te pronaći ubojicu... Ali i naći ljubav u Manuelovom zagrljaju. Idućeg dana još jedan nesretni događaj unese pomutnju na imanje. Tomás je pronađen mrtav. Narednik Conrado, pripadnik civilne garde, odlučan je u svom naumu da pronađe ubojicu. Svi dokazi upućuju na Janu jer ona je posljednja osoba s kojom je Tomás prije smrti razgovarao. R.: Miguel Cond...

programme.desc: Graffiti - (E04, Doc. Film, Croatia, 2025) In the fourth episode, we explore in which all the ways of drawing on the street walls can make money. Due to visual attractiveness and ubiquity in cities, graffiti has quickly become interesting to advertisers from marginal subculture. Darko Bosnar, a marketing expert with many years of experience, reveals that he used to draw graffiti himself, and today he uses them in marketing campaigns. As time went on and he became more and more famous, the volume of work grew. Not all Solo players are, so the 2010s created the collective "Gradele Gradele", which, in addition to the festival, also organizes commercial drafting projects for various clients and marketing agencies. In Berlin, the head of the Urban Art Museum, Urban Nation explains that the construction concern is funded by young artists and their projects. In Tokyo, Marina Mesar explains to us that she was able to come from drawing in Zagreb's streets to exhibitions around galleries around the world. Elena Calderon Alez presents us with her company that deals with the digitization of graffiti and street art in Tokyo and connects street artists from all over the world with their Japanese colleagues. The murals are also lucrative for major corporations. Specifically, Tennoz, a former swampy island, turned into something rare in Japan, a brand new housing zone. Darko Bosnar, marketinški stručnjak s višegodišnjim iskustvom, otkriva kako je i sam nekada crtao grafite, a danas ih koristi u marketinškim kampanjama. Likovni umjetnik Lunar otkriva nam kako je već ranih devedesetih počeo zarađivati kao grafiter crtajući reklame po kvartu. Kako je vrijeme teklo i on postajao sve poznatiji, rastao je i obujam posla. Nisu svi solo igrači, tako da se 2010-ih stvorio kolektiv "Grafiti na gradele" koji osim festivala organizira i komercijalne projekte crtanja murala za razne klijente i marketinške agencije. Osnivač Marko Boko otkriva nam da su kroz mrežu poznanstava s grafiterima, street artistima i muralistima prisutni u svim većim gradovima u Hrvatskoj te zapravo obavljaju funkciju svojevrsne grafiti agencije. U Berlinu, voditelj muzeja urbane umjetnosti Urban Nation objašnjava kako građevinski koncern financira mlade likovne umjetnike i njihove projekte. U Tokyju nam Marina Mesar OKO objašnjava kako je ona uspjela doći od crtanja po zagrebačkim ulicama do izložbi po galerijama po cijelom svijetu. Elena Calderon Alez predstavlja nam svoju tvrtku koja se u Tokyju bavi digitalizacijom grafita i street arta te spaja ulične umjetnike iz cijelog svijeta s njihovim japanskim kolegama. Murali su unosni i za velike korporacije. Soh Wadamoto, čelnik Terrada Warehouse projekta, okuplja nekoliko desetaka korporacija koje muralima žele učiniti otok Tennoz primamljivim za investitore i stanovnike. programme.desc: Holy Mountains of the World - (E04, Traveling Series, Croatia, 2005) A thousand kilometers away from civilization, in the middle of the Tibetic desolate plateau, as a mountain crystal stands a lonely pyramid of rocks and ice. Kailash. What for the old Greeks was Olympus or for Christians St. Mountain on Sinai, this is still this mountain for Hindu, Buddhist and followers of Bon, the pre -banking religion in Tibet. For Hindu, this mountain is the throne of the Almighty God of Shiva, and for Buddhists a huge natural mandala or a wheel of life. For both religions it is the origin of the Tantric forces and the center of the universe. In the shadow of this holy mountain, at an altitude of 4500 meters, Lake Mansarowar lies from Brahma's thoughts. Even for unbelievers, mountains and lake are rare gems of magical beauty, clean light and expressed colors. The HTV team, author of the Stipe Bozic series and cameraman Josko Bojic, follow the pilgrimage around Kailas, which the Tibetans call the bark, lasts from 3 to 5 days and everyone is looking forward to him, most of them children. Most Indians prefer to ride on Jacobs, although it can be more dangerous than walking itself. For some of the Tibetan pilgrims, the bark is a prostration, all the way around Kailash. Through which is 50 kilometers long and climbs to an altitude of 5700 meters. The most difficult part of the pilgrimage is over 5700 meters high saddle Drows La. Here many Indian pilgrims, unaccustomed to diluted air, give up because of a height disease. Each year, 6 pilgrims die on an average of an average. Za hinduiste ova je planina prijestolje svemoćnog boga Šive, a za budiste golema prirodna mandala ili kotač života. Za obje religije to je ishodište tantričkih sila i središte svemira. U sjeni ove svete planine, na nadmorskoj visini od 4500 metara, leži jezero Mansarowar, rođeno iz Brahminih misli. Čak i za nevjernike, planina i jezero rijetki su dragulji magične ljepote, čistoga svjetla i izraženih boja. Ekipa HTV-a, autor serije Stipe Božić i snimatelj Joško Bojić, prate hodočašće oko Kailasa, koje Tibetanci zovu kora, traje od 3 do 5 dana i svi mu se vesele, a najviše djeca. Većina Indijaca radije jaše na jakovima, iako to može biti opasnije od samog hodanja. Za neke od tibetanskih hodočasnika kora je prostracija, i to cijelim putem oko Kailasha. Putem koji je dug 50 kilometara, a penje se do nadmorske visine od 5700 metara. Najteži dio hodočašća prelazak je preko 5700 metara visokog sedla Drolma La. For millions of years, various species produced various poisons, either for defense either for the attack, and where we can find these small chemical factories will reveal to us the Solta submarine. Solta was largely intact and the same as at the time when fishermen from the south, harsh side, sailing at the foot of Teuta's courts, threw part of the catch into the sea for gratitude to the gods for the generous catch. The masters of Solta are birds, and the most famous is the little owl beauty Cuk or Cuvita as they call her Soltani. R.: Miro Andrić ... / Hrvatsko podmorje - (S04, E04, znan. pop. serija, Hrvatska, 2008) U niski velikih i dobro poznatih otoka Hvara, Brača, pa i Trogiru bliskog Čiova smjestio se jedan nepravedno gotovo zaboravljen otok, često zanemarivan zbog većih i bližih. Podmorje je bogato, razigrano, raznoliko, a upravo smo takvo i tražili kako bi vam pokazali tematsku priču o otrovnim bićima dubina. Milijunima godina razne vrste proizvodile su razne otrove, bilo za obranu bilo za napad, a gdje sve možemo naći te male kemijske tvornice otkrit će nam podmorje Šolte. Šolta je velikim dijelom ostala netaknuta i ista kao u ono vrijeme kada su ribari s južne, surovije strane, ploveći podno Teutinih dvora bacali dio ulova u more u zahvalnost bogovima za izdašni ulov. Why the decision of the Mayor of Pula is questionable and why Croats listen to folk, turbofolk and trap, tonight in the show, Alexei Gotthardi Pavlovsky, the author of the only book on the phenomenon of folk and turbofolk in Croatia and Tomislav Plenetac, a cultural anthropologist. programme.title: A book or life / Knjiga ili život
programme.desc: Book or Life - (Artistic Program, Croatia, 2022) in the studio we talk to Professor Tomislav Brlek, author of the anthology of modern Croatian poetry "Matos to Maleš" in which poets whose oeuvre, by the author's view, reflect modernity and who pervade each other, influencing and forming a causal series from Matos. A colleague Jasna Coce in Trogir spoke with the laureates of the competition "Talking around the City", organized by the local library, and referred to the literary heritage of the City of Trogir. Two contemporary Serbian writers, Goran Skobonja and Oto, presented Croatian readers their books in which they combine various genres, from science fiction to thrillers and historical readers ... / Knjiga ili život - (umjetnički program, Hrvatska, 2022) U studiju razgovaramo s profesorom Tomislavom Brlekom, autorom Antologije moderne hrvatske poezije "Od Matoša do Maleša" u kojoj su zastupljeni pjesnici čiji opusi, po autorovom viđenju, odražavaju modernost i koji se međusobno prožimaju, utječući i formirajući uzročno-posljedični niz od Matoša pa do Maleša. Kolegica Jasna Coce u Trogiru je razgovarala s laureatima natječaja "Priča se po gradu", u organizaciji mjesne knjižnice, a osvrnula se i na književnu baštinu grada Trogira. Dvojica suvremenih srpskih pisaca, Goran Skrobonja i Oto Oltvanju, hrvatskim su čitateljima predstavili svoje knjige u kojima kombiniraju razne žanrove, od znanstvene fantastike do trilera i povijesne čitanke...

programme.title: The world of classics / Svijet klasike
programme.desc: Classic World - (Music. A show, Croatia, 2017) Labuđe Lake is one of the most famous ballets of all time, just side by side with a nut of the same composer, Petra Iljic Tchaikovsky. When children see the swans on the theater scene, they immediately want to be ballerinas and balletons. Therefore, it is important to maintain the highest level of the performance of this important title on the repertoire of a national theater. The HNK in Zagreb therefore invited two champions of the prestigious Milan Scale that in the magical choreography of Vladimir Malakhovo they dance two main roles, Prince Siegfried and the enchanted princess in the face of Odette/Odili Labudica. He is the Timofej Latvian Andrijashenko, and that Italian Nicoletta Mani, both are private and professional partners. But how is it to dance to the ensemble now in such a competition, with quite different conditions of schooling and development? We are greatly held by our two better soloists with a great perspective, Anamarija Markovic and Valentina Strok, who, with the director of Zagreb Ballet Massimiliana Volpini and Zagreb Ballet National Champion Tomislav Petranovic, present on the show ... / Svijet klasike - (glazb. emisija, Hrvatska, 2017) Labuđe jezero jedan je od najpoznatijih baleta svih vremena, odmah uz bok Orašaru istog skladatelja, Petra Iljiča Čajkovskog. Kada djeca ugledaju labudice na kazališnoj sceni, odmah požele biti balerine i baletani. Stoga je važno održavati najvišu razinu izvedbe tog važnog naslova na repertoaru jednog nacionalnog kazališta. HNK u Zagrebu stoga je pozvao dvoje prvaka prestižne milanske Scale da u čarobnoj koreografiji Vladimira Malakhova otplešu dvije glavne uloge, princa Siegfrieda i začarane princeze u liku labudice Odette/Odilije. On je Latvijac Timofej Andrijašenko, a ona Talijanka Nicoletta Mani, oboje su privatni i profesionalni partneri. Ali kako je sada Hrvaticama u ansamblu plesati u takvoj konkurenciji, uz sasvim drukčije uvjete školovanja i razvoja? Sjajno se drže naše dvije sve bolje solistice s velikom perspektivom, Anamarija Marković i Valentina Štrok, koje uz ravnatelja Zagrebačkog baleta Massimiliana Volpinija te zagrebačkog baletnog nacionalnog prvaka Tomislava Petranovića predstavljamo u emisiji...

programme.title: The world of jazz / Svijet jazza
programme.desc: Jazza World - (Music. A show, Croatia, 2018) There are a lot of great musicians in Croatia playing on various occasions in a wide variety of combinations. But how does a really good jazz surgery come about? Zagreb drummer Kruno Levacic after who knows how much permutation and change he has formed with three young musicians - Ivar Roban Križić, Luka Žužić and Marija Bočić - Quartet Problems. As a composition without a harmonic instrument, piano or guitar, it seems to be easily released by stereotypes. They adapt to the place where they play and to the audience, which goes to these places, adapt to each other, play their own and others, but every time differently. In doing so, they rely not only on our own experience and talent, but also to what we can call musical intelligence. Enough of the most profitable lovers are no longer considered a promising band, but a band that pretends to a leading place on the Croatian jazz bridge. As a tireless music philosopher, Kruno Levacic always raises a essential question about how to play in a band that is not boring. Maybe he finally found the answer in trouble. R.: Melanija Povic Jagarinec ... / Svijet jazza - (glazb. emisija, Hrvatska, 2018) U Hrvatskoj ima puno sjajnih muzičara koji sviraju u raznim prigodama u najrazličitijim kombinacijama. No, kako nastaje zaista dobar jazz-sastav? Zagrebački bubnjar Kruno Levačić nakon tko zna koliko permutacija i izmjena oformio je s trojicom mladih glazbenika - Ivarom Robanom Križićem, Lukom Žužićem i Marijem Bočićem - kvartet Problemi. Kao sastav bez harmonijskog instrumenta, klavira ili gitare, čini se da se lako oslobađaju stereotipova. Prilagođavaju se mjestu gdje sviraju i publici koja na ta mjesta zalazi, prilagođavaju se jedni drugima, sviraju svoje i tuđe, ali svaki puta drugačije. Pri tome se oslanjaju ne samo na vlastito iskustvo i talent, nego i na ono što bismo mogli nazvati glazbenom inteligencijom. Dovoljno da ih se u krugovima najprofinjenijih ljubitelja više ne smatra perspektivnim bendom, nego bendom koji pretendira na vodeće mjesto na hrvatskoj jazz-sceni. Kao neumoran glazbeni filozof, Kruno Levačić uvijek i iznova postavlja suštinsko pitanje o tome kako svirati u bendu koji nije dosadan. Možda je upravo u Problemima konačno pronašao odgovor. R.: Melanija Pović Jagarinec...

programme.title: Legends of Paris romanticism / Legende Pariškog romantizma
programme.desc: Larmee des Romantiques - (E03, Art Program, France, 2024) The French Revolution of February 1848 demolished the monarchy and brought poets to power. Lamartine proclaims the Republic. The Republic of the Republic is also joined by Dumas, Hugo and Sand. But when the new president should be elected, the French people are elected by Louis Napoleon Bonaparte. Elected to the National Assembly in the ranks of the conservative side, Hugo still feels that his beliefs were shaken. The writer simply cannot close his eyes to the misery that surrounds him. One young painter comes to the center of attention by painting ordinary people - Gustave Courbet inventing realism. Balzac dies behind, leaving a colossal oeuvre that has exhausted every drop of his energy. Louis Napoleon is declared an emperor, which encourages Hugoa to definitely turn to the left in political terms. The writer has no choice but to escape from France. Dumas is also forced to leave for personal bankruptcy. The two of them, therefore, will not be able to say goodbye to their friend Nerval at the funeral. R .: Amelie Harrault Ul.: Cecile de France (La Narratrice) ... / Larmee des romantiques - (E03, umjetnički program, Francuska, 2024) Francuska revolucija iz veljače 1848. srušila je Monarhiju i na vlast dovela pjesnike. Lamartine proglašava Republiku. Projektu Republike pridružuju se i Dumas, Hugo i Sand. No kad treba izabrati novog predsjednika, francuski narod bira Luja Napoleona Bonapartea. Izabran u Narodnu skupštinu u redovima konzervativne strane, Hugo ipak osjeća kako su mu uvjerenja poljuljana. Književnik naprosto ne može zatvoriti oči pred bijedom koja ga okružuje. Jedan mladi slikar dolazi u središte pozornosti slikajući obične ljude - Gustave Courbet izmišlja realizam. Balzac umire za sobom ostavljajući kolosalan opus koji je iscrpio svaku kap njegove energije. Luj Napoleon proglašava se carem, što Hugoa potiče da u političkom smislu definitivno skrene ulijevo. Pisac nema drugog izbora nego pobjeći iz Francuske. Dumas je također prisiljen otići zbog osobnog bankrota. Njih se dvojica stoga neće moći na sprovodu oprostiti od svog prijatelja Nervala. R.: Amelie Harrault Ul.: Cecile de France (la narratrice)...

programme.title: Legends of Paris romanticism / Legende Pariškog romantizma
programme.desc: Larmee des Romantiques - (E04, Artistic Program, France, 2024) in the exile on the island of Guernsey Hugo again reveals a passion for large novels. With the help of Juliette Drouet, he finishes "poor people" while the young generation of artists in Paris is fighting for his place. "Mrs. Bovary", "Flowers of Evil", "Breakfast on the Grass" - all these works of art is cenzured. Delacroix dies, leaving Baudelaire in art as an orphan. The poet feels like he no longer belongs to the new, glittering Paris created by Georges-Eugène Haussmann. Allergic to modernization, he retreats into the exile to Belgium, returning to France just before death. Nadar raises the photo to the level of a new artistic form, drawing inspiration from the first futuristic novels of Jules Verne. But the war soon brings to the end of the rule of Napoleon III. Hugo returns to France as a hero. Together with Sand, Gautier and Dumas, he finally testifies to the triumph of freedom and the Republic. R .: Amelie Harrault Ul.: Cecile de France (La Narratrice) ... / Larmee des romantiques - (E04, umjetnički program, Francuska, 2024) U izgnanstvu na otoku Guernsey Hugo ponovno otkriva strast za velikim romanima. Uz pomoć Juliette Drouet dovršava "Jadnike" dok se mladi naraštaj umjetnika u Parizu pak bori za svoje mjesto. "Gospođa Bovary", "Cvjetovi zla", "Doručak na travi" - sva su ta umjetnička djela cenzurirana. Delacroix umire, ostavljajući Baudelairea u umjetničkom smislu kao siroče. Pjesnik se osjeća kao da više ne pripada novom, blještavom Parizu koji je stvorio Georges-Eugène Haussmann. Alergičan na modernizaciju, povlači se u izgnanstvo u Belgiju, vraćajući se u Francusku tek pred smrt. Nadar fotografiju podiže na razinu nove umjetničke forme, crpeći nadahnuće iz prvih futurističkih romana Julesa Vernea. No rat ubrzo donosi kraj vladavini Napoleona III. Hugo se u Francusku vraća kao heroj. Zajedno sa Sand, Gautierom i Dumasom, napokon svjedoči trijumfu slobode i Republike. R.: Amelie Harrault Ul.: Cecile de France (la narratrice)...

programme.title: The world of jazz / Svijet jazza
programme.desc: Jazza World - (Music. A show, Croatia, 2018) There are a lot of great musicians in Croatia playing on various occasions in a wide variety of combinations. But how does a really good jazz surgery come about? Zagreb drummer Kruno Levacic after who knows how much permutation and change he has formed with three young musicians - Ivar Roban Križić, Luka Žužić and Marija Bočić - Quartet Problems. As a composition without a harmonic instrument, piano or guitar, it seems to be easily released by stereotypes. They adapt to the place where they play and to the audience, which goes to these places, adapt to each other, play their own and others, but every time differently. In doing so, they rely not only on our own experience and talent, but also to what we can call musical intelligence. Enough of the most profitable lovers are no longer considered a promising band, but a band that pretends to a leading place on the Croatian jazz bridge. As a tireless music philosopher, Kruno Levacic always raises a essential question about how to play in a band that is not boring. Maybe he finally found the answer in trouble. R.: Melanija Povic Jagarinec ... / Svijet jazza - (glazb. emisija, Hrvatska, 2018) U Hrvatskoj ima puno sjajnih muzičara koji sviraju u raznim prigodama u najrazličitijim kombinacijama. No, kako nastaje zaista dobar jazz-sastav? Zagrebački bubnjar Kruno Levačić nakon tko zna koliko permutacija i izmjena oformio je s trojicom mladih glazbenika - Ivarom Robanom Križićem, Lukom Žužićem i Marijem Bočićem - kvartet Problemi. Kao sastav bez harmonijskog instrumenta, klavira ili gitare, čini se da se lako oslobađaju stereotipova. Prilagođavaju se mjestu gdje sviraju i publici koja na ta mjesta zalazi, prilagođavaju se jedni drugima, sviraju svoje i tuđe, ali svaki puta drugačije. Pri tome se oslanjaju ne samo na vlastito iskustvo i talent, nego i na ono što bismo mogli nazvati glazbenom inteligencijom. Dovoljno da ih se u krugovima najprofinjenijih ljubitelja više ne smatra perspektivnim bendom, nego bendom koji pretendira na vodeće mjesto na hrvatskoj jazz-sceni. Kao neumoran glazbeni filozof, Kruno Levačić uvijek i iznova postavlja suštinsko pitanje o tome kako svirati u bendu koji nije dosadan. Možda je upravo u Problemima konačno pronašao odgovor. R.: Melanija Pović Jagarinec...

U antičko vrijeme smatralo se da se ni jedan smrtnik ne smije približiti bogovima, a nekmoli se, ne daj Bože, uputiti prema njihovu staništu na vrhu planine. Njegova su lutanja, doduše, više kopnenim nego morskim prostranstvima. Na Olimpu je jesen, zato već ima nešto snijega, što uspon čini složenijim. Sada je još jasnije da će snimatelj Joško Bojić s kamerom morati ostati u podnožju vršne stijene odakle će Božića moći pratiti kroz teleobjektiv videokamere. R.: Stipe Božić...

programme.desc: Classic World - (Music. A show, Croatia, 2024), while some opera houses for the 100th anniversary of the death of the great composer Giacomo Puccini are exploring his lesser -known works, the Croatian National Theater in Zagreb turns to his most famous opera - La Boheme. What we translate as a bohemian is, in fact, the story of a family of young artists and philosophers whose rented Paris attic of a Christmas evening enters the Swimming evening, looking for a flame for the extinguished candle. One of them will accidentally be lagging behind the company and warming her ice handle, which is just the beginning of their life passionate but unhappy love. The dry girl already loses his breath in the first performance, and in the last scene dies, leaving behind an unbearable void. Since Puccini in the late 19th century had a story from the 1840s, so did the director Mario Pontiggia a similar time distance to our viewers, housing the shop in the 1950s. We follow the general experiment with the premiere division of the artist consisting of Lana Kos (Mimi), Darija Auguštan (Musetta), Matteo Lippi (Rodolfi), Ljubomir Puškarić (Marcello), Giovanni Romeo (Schaunard), Luciano Batinić (Coline) and Ivan Šimatović (Benoit) Zagreb Opera, Italian Maestro Pier Giorgio Morandi ... / Svijet klasike - (glazb. emisija, Hrvatska, 2024) Dok neke operne kuće za 100. godišnjicu smrti velikog skladatelja Giacoma Puccinija istražuju njegova manje poznata djela, Hrvatsko narodno kazalište u Zagrebu okreće se njegovoj najpoznatijoj operi - La boheme. Ono što prevodimo kao boemština, u stvari je priča o družini mladih umjetnika i filozofa u čije iznajmljeno pariško potkrovlje jedne badnje večeri ulazi švelja tražeći plamičak za ugaslu svijeću. Jedan će od njih slučajno zaostati za družinom i ugrijati joj ledenu ručicu, što je tek početak njihove životne strastvene, ali nesretne ljubavi. Sušičava djevojka već u prvom nastupu gubi dah, a u posljednjem prizoru umire ostavljajući za sobom nepodnošljivu prazninu. Kako je Puccini krajem 19. stoljeća uglazbljivao priču iz 1840-ih, tako je i redatelj Mario Pontiggia dao našim gledateljima sličnu vremensku distancu smjestivši radnju u pedesete godine 20. stoljeća. Pratimo generalni pokus s premijernom podjelom umjetnika koju čine Lana Kos (Mimi), Darija Auguštan (Musetta), Matteo Lippi (Rodolfo), Ljubomir Puškarić (Marcello), Giovanni Romeo (Schaunard), Luciano Batinić (Coline) i Ivan Šimatović (Benoit) dok izvedbom ravna počasni šef dirigent Zagrebačke opere, talijanski maestro Pier Giorgio Morandi...

The poet feels like he no longer belongs to the new, glittering Paris created by Georges-Eugène Haussmann. Allergic to modernization, he retreats into the exile to Belgium, returning to France just before death. Hugo returns to France as a hero. Together with Sand, Gautier and Dumas, he finally testifies to the triumph of freedom and the Republic. Alergičan na modernizaciju, povlači se u izgnanstvo u Belgiju, vraćajući se u Francusku tek pred smrt. Nadar fotografiju podiže na razinu nove umjetničke forme, crpeći nadahnuće iz prvih futurističkih romana Julesa Vernea. No rat ubrzo donosi kraj vladavini Napoleona III. programme.title: Carl Orff "Carmina Burana" / Carl Orff "Carmina Burana"
programme.desc: Carl Orff "Carmina Burana" - (Show Magazine, Croatia, 2021) On the sunny side of Prisavlje we bring the performance of Carmina Bunaran Carl Orff. The German composer chose poems from the collection of medieval poetry of goliaths, that is, traveling clerics, students and poets, and were discovered in 1803 in Benedictine Opatija in Beuren, by whose Latinized name she was a collection and was named, although it was most likely to be created in Austria. Today, it is considered one of the most important sources of Latin medieval worldly poetry, and is kept in the Bavarian State Library in Munich. Between numerous humor and lasciviousness of spicy songs in Latin, German and medieval French about the joys of earthly life, the Orff, with the help of Latin's Latin connoisseurs, Michael Hoffman, chose 24 songs and conceptualized them as a stage cantat. Its three parts - in the spring, in the tavern and love competition, with a dramatic introduction and conclusion that call the goddess of the fate Fortun, represent a series of living allegorical images of love, hedonism, but also religion, in whose background the Moto Fortuna Imperatrix Mundi lies - Fortuna's ruler of the world. The cantata has experienced a number of stage performances variants, but today it is most often performed by concert. Thanks to the popularity, numerous arrangements were created, including the one from 1956, made by Orff's student Wilhlem Killmayer, which the composer himself approved. It is a reduced version for soloists, a choir, two piano and six percussionists that enables the performance of cantata and in smaller bands, which we will just watch in the interpretation of the HRT and Maestra Tomislav Facini Association with renowned soloists, soprano Margarete Klobučar, Tenor Marko Antolković and Bariton Matija Meić. Viktor Cizic and Petar Krokar are for the piano. R .: Mirena Stijačić ... / Carl Orff "Carmina Burana" - (show magazin, Hrvatska, 2021) Na Sunčanoj strani Prisavlja donosimo izvedbu kantate Carmina Burana Carla Orffa. Njemački skladatelj izabrao je pjesme iz zbirke srednjovjekovne poezije golijarda, odnosno putujućih klerika, studenata i pjesnika, a otkrivene su 1803. u benediktinskoj opatiji u Beurenu, po čijem je latiniziranom imenu zbirka i dobila ime, iako je najvjerojatnije nastala u Austriji. Danas ju se smatra jednim od najvažnijih izvora latinske srednjovjekovne svjetovne poezije, a čuva se u Bavarskoj državnoj biblioteci u Munchenu. Između brojnih humorom i lascivnošću začinjenih pjesama na latinskom, njemačkom i srednjovjekovnom francuskom jeziku o radostima zemaljskog života, Orff je, uz pomoć studenta prava i poznavatelja latinskog jezika Michaela Hoffmana, izabrao 24 pjesme te ih je koncipirao kao scensku kantatu. Njezina tri dijela - U proljeće, U krčmi i Ljubavno nadmetanje, s dramatičnim uvodom i zaključkom koji zazivaju božicu sudbine Fortunu, predstavljaju niz živih alegorijskih slika ljubavi, hedonizma, ali i religije, u čijoj pozadini leži moto Fortuna imperatrix mundi - Fortuna vladarica svijeta. Kantata je doživjela niz varijanti scenskih izvedbi, no danas se najčešće izvodi koncertno. Zahvaljujući popularnosti nastali su i brojni aranžmani, među kojima je i onaj iz 1956. koji je načinio Orffov učenik Wilhlem Killmayer, a koji je sam skladatelj odobrio. Riječ je o reduciranoj verziji za soliste, zbor, dva klavira i šest udaraljkaša koja omogućuje izvedbu kantate i u manjim sastavima, a koju ćemo upravo gledati u interpretaciji Zbora HRT-a i maestra Tomislava Fačinija uz renomirane soliste, sopranisticu Margarete Klobučar, tenora Marka Antolkovića i baritona Matiju Meića. programme.title: Vukovar Film Festival 2025 - Chronicles / Vukovar film festival 2025. - kronike
programme.desc: Vukovar Film Festival 2025. - Chronicles - (E01, Cult. Magazine, Croatia, 2025), from August 27 to 30, the 19th Vukovar Film Festival, a unique film event that brings together productions from the Danube countries. This year, the big movie hits are coming to Vukovar - among them the Brazilian Oscar -winning "I'm still here", the winner of Cannes "A regular incident", as well as the most watched Hungarian film of all time, a family comedy race for life, which will have its Croatian premiere here. The main festival program will take place at an attractive location - in the Eltz Castle Park, and the novelty is also the possibility of an earlier online ticket purchase through Entrio service. In addition to film screenings, the festival also brings a special children's program, as well as film evenings at the unique location of the Vukovar Water Tower Amphitheater. Organizers emphasize an increase in interest - nearly 300 films from all over the world have arrived this year ... / Vukovar film festival 2025. - kronike - (E01, kult. magazin, Hrvatska, 2025) Od 27. do 30. kolovoza održava se 19. Vukovarski filmski festival, jedinstveni filmski događaj koji okuplja produkcije iz podunavskih zemalja. Ove godine u Vukovar stižu veliki filmski hitovi - među njima i brazilski Oscarovac "Još sam tu", pobjednik Cannesa "Jedan običan incident", kao i najgledaniji mađarski film svih vremena, obiteljska komedija Trka za život, koja će upravo ovdje imati svoju hrvatsku premijeru. Glavni festivalski program odvijat će se na atraktivnoj lokaciji - u perivoju dvorca Eltz, a novost je i mogućnost ranije online kupnje ulaznica putem servisa Entrio. Uz filmske projekcije, festival donosi i poseban dječji program, kao i filmske večeri na jedinstvenoj lokaciji amfiteatra Vukovarskog vodotornja. Organizatori ističu porast interesa - ove godine pristiglo je gotovo 300 prijava filmova iz cijelog svijeta...

programme.title: What is a classic? / Što je klasik?
programme.desc: What is a classic? - (Cult. Magazine, Croatia, 2025) In 1954. Radovan Ivsic went to Medvednica to live in a lugarnica, without running water and electricity, without a phone. He could no longer be understood almost with any of the intellectuals who agreed one after the other to loyalty to socialist realism. He remained true to his artistic ideals - absolute freedom of expression and rebellion against the default borders. His "King Gordogan" is a dramatic classic, but only after almost one century since its origin was set on the CNT boards in Zagreb. Why? Find out this in the show what is the classic? in which director Rene Medvesek and actor Ozren Grabarić speak. R.: Ivo Kuzmanic ... / Što je klasik? - (kult. magazin, Hrvatska, 2025) Godine 1954. Radovan Ivšić odlazi na Medvednicu živjeti u lugarnici, bez tekuće vode i električne energije, bez telefona. Nije se više mogao razumjeti gotovo ni s kim od intelektualaca koji su jedan za drugim pristali na vjernost socijalističkom realizmu. On je ostajao vjeran svojim umjetničkim idealima - apsolutnoj slobodi izražavanja i pobuni protiv zadanih granica. Njegov "Kralj Gordogan" dramski je klasik, no tek nakon gotovo jednog stoljeća od nastanka postavljen je na daske HNK u Zagrebu. Zašto? Doznajte to u emisiji Što je klasik? u kojoj govore redatelj Rene Medvešek i glumac Ozren Grabarić. R.: Ivo Kuzmanić...

programme.title: Liburnia Film Festival 2025 - Chronicles / Liburnia Film Festival 2025. - kronike
programme.desc: Liburnia Film Festival 2025 - Chronicles - (E01, Art Magazine, Croatia, 2025) The Liburnia Film Festival is the oldest festival dedicated to the Croatian documentary. For more than two decades, she has been following, promoting and rewarding domestic documentary production. This year's 23rd edition is held from August 26 to August 30 at recognizable festival locations - the Opatija Summer Stage and Vili Antonio. The audience expects the selection of the best recent Croatian documentaries, but the festival is not only a screening of films, but also a place of active dialogue and education. The Liburnia Film Festival also brings a discursive program as part of the stands and conversations with the authors, which provide the audience with insight into the film creation, motives, challenges and context behind the camera. In addition to great films and interesting conversations with the authors, children and young people have the opportunity to get involved in the workshops that provide them with an introduction to the documentary world, develop media literacy and encourage creative expression. With the rich program of the Liburnia Film Festival, this year it opens up space for watching, learning and dialogue ... / Liburnia Film Festival 2025. - kronike - (E01, umjetnički magazin, Hrvatska, 2025) Liburnia Film Festival najstariji je festival posvećen isključivo hrvatskom dokumentarnom filmu. Već više od dva desetljeća prati, promovira i nagrađuje domaću dokumentarističku produkciju. Ovogodišnje, 23. izdanje održava se od 26. do 30. kolovoza na prepoznatljivim festivalskim lokacijama - opatijskoj Ljetnoj pozornici i Vili Antonio. Publiku očekuje selekcija najboljih recentnih hrvatskih dokumentaraca, no Festival nije samo projekcija filmova, već i mjesto aktivnog dijaloga i edukacije. Liburnia Film Festival donosi i diskurzivni program u sklopu kojeg se održavaju tribine i razgovori s autorima, koji publici omogućuju uvid u proces nastanka filma, motive, izazove i kontekst iza kamere. Osim sjajnih filmova i zanimljivih razgovora s autorima, djeca i mladi imaju se priliku uključiti u radionice koje im pružaju uvod u svijet dokumentarnog filma, razvijaju medijsku pismenost i potiču kreativno izražavanje. S bogatim programom Liburnia Film Festival i ove godine otvara prostor za gledanje, učenje i dijalog...
