programme.title: Carl Orff "Carmina Burana" / Carl Orff "Carmina Burana"
programme.desc: Carl Orff "Carmina Burana" - (Show Magazine, Croatia, 2021) On the sunny side of Prisavlje we bring the performance of Carmina Bunaran Carl Orff. The German composer chose poems from the collection of medieval poetry of goliaths, that is, traveling clerics, students and poets, and were discovered in 1803 in Benedictine Opatija in Beuren, by whose Latinized name she was a collection and was named, although it was most likely to be created in Austria. Today, it is considered one of the most important sources of Latin medieval worldly poetry, and is kept in the Bavarian State Library in Munich. Between numerous humor and lasciviousness of spicy songs in Latin, German and medieval French about the joys of earthly life, the Orff, with the help of Latin's Latin connoisseurs, Michael Hoffman, chose 24 songs and conceptualized them as a stage cantat. Its three parts - in the spring, in the tavern and love competition, with a dramatic introduction and conclusion that call the goddess of the fate Fortun, represent a series of living allegorical images of love, hedonism, but also religion, in whose background the Moto Fortuna Imperatrix Mundi lies - Fortuna's ruler of the world. The cantata has experienced a number of stage performances variants, but today it is most often performed by concert. Thanks to the popularity, numerous arrangements were created, including the one from 1956, made by Orff's student Wilhlem Killmayer, which the composer himself approved. It is a reduced version for soloists, a choir, two piano and six percussionists that enables the performance of cantata and in smaller bands, which we will just watch in the interpretation of the HRT and Maestra Tomislav Facini Association with renowned soloists, soprano Margarete Klobučar, Tenor Marko Antolković and Bariton Matija Meić. Viktor Cizic and Petar Krokar are for the piano. R .: Mirena Stijačić ... / Carl Orff "Carmina Burana" - (show magazin, Hrvatska, 2021) Na Sunčanoj strani Prisavlja donosimo izvedbu kantate Carmina Burana Carla Orffa. Njemački skladatelj izabrao je pjesme iz zbirke srednjovjekovne poezije golijarda, odnosno putujućih klerika, studenata i pjesnika, a otkrivene su 1803. u benediktinskoj opatiji u Beurenu, po čijem je latiniziranom imenu zbirka i dobila ime, iako je najvjerojatnije nastala u Austriji. Danas ju se smatra jednim od najvažnijih izvora latinske srednjovjekovne svjetovne poezije, a čuva se u Bavarskoj državnoj biblioteci u Munchenu. Između brojnih humorom i lascivnošću začinjenih pjesama na latinskom, njemačkom i srednjovjekovnom francuskom jeziku o radostima zemaljskog života, Orff je, uz pomoć studenta prava i poznavatelja latinskog jezika Michaela Hoffmana, izabrao 24 pjesme te ih je koncipirao kao scensku kantatu. Njezina tri dijela - U proljeće, U krčmi i Ljubavno nadmetanje, s dramatičnim uvodom i zaključkom koji zazivaju božicu sudbine Fortunu, predstavljaju niz živih alegorijskih slika ljubavi, hedonizma, ali i religije, u čijoj pozadini leži moto Fortuna imperatrix mundi - Fortuna vladarica svijeta. Kantata je doživjela niz varijanti scenskih izvedbi, no danas se najčešće izvodi koncertno. Zahvaljujući popularnosti nastali su i brojni aranžmani, među kojima je i onaj iz 1956. koji je načinio Orffov učenik Wilhlem Killmayer, a koji je sam skladatelj odobrio. Riječ je o reduciranoj verziji za soliste, zbor, dva klavira i šest udaraljkaša koja omogućuje izvedbu kantate i u manjim sastavima, a koju ćemo upravo gledati u interpretaciji Zbora HRT-a i maestra Tomislava Fačinija uz renomirane soliste, sopranisticu Margarete Klobučar, tenora Marka Antolkovića i baritona Matiju Meića. Za glasovirima su Viktor Čižić i Petar Krokar. R.: Mirena Stijačić...

programme.title: Out of format / Izvan formata
programme.desc: Out of format - (Artistic Program, Croatia, 2025) After half a century of photographic work and more than a hundred solo exhibitions in Croatia and the world, Damir Fabijanić, although in retirement, is by no means still. Namely, for the first time in the City Museum of Pakrac, he fully presented his cycle in Croatia with extremely poignant and strong photographs of war destruction of Croatian cultural heritage. The exhibition "The Fruits of Evil" that has been waiting for 30 years is the best reason to talk to a photographer that says that it is shameful that the valorisation of artistic works on the theme of the Homeland War has never been made in Croatia. And we ask him why his monograph "Dubrovnik", which the distinguished Paris publisher Marval has included among the most beautiful books of the world, today it is impossible to buy at the Dubrovnik museums. R.: Vesna Lukovic Žarno ... / Izvan formata - (umjetnički program, Hrvatska, 2025) Nakon pola stoljeća fotografskog rada i više od stotinu samostalnih izložbi u Hrvatskoj i svijetu Damir Fabijanić, iako je u mirovini, nikako ne miruje. Naime, u Gradskom muzeju Pakraca prvi je put u Hrvatskoj u cijelosti predstavio svoj ciklus iznimno potresnih i snažnih fotografija ratnog razaranja hrvatske kulturne baštine. Izložba "Plodovi zla" koju se čekalo 30 godina najbolji je povod za razgovor s fotografom koji kaže da je sramotno da nikad u Hrvatskoj nije napravljena valorizacija umjetničkih radova na temu Domovinskog rata. A mi ga pitamo zašto je njegovu monografsku knjigu "Dubrovnik", koju je ugledni pariški nakladnik Marval uvrstio među najljepše knjige svijeta, danas nemoguće kupiti u dubrovačkim muzejima. R.: Vesna Luković Žarn...

programme.title: Romano Bolkovic - 1 on 1 / Romano Bolković - 1 na 1
programme.desc: Romano Bolkovic - 1 to 1 - (Talk Show, Croatia, 2025) with guest Nenad Bakic we will discuss the public concentration on Trump as a person, not the political processes he triggers on, the reasons and effects of the abolition of USAID and Harangi against Elon Musk, the fears of the oligarchy, the male and its influence, on the position of Europe, On the demographic projections of Croatia, the abolition of the fact-checking, the results of the robotic league and the stem of literacy, the AI ​​revolution, about why the problem is in education, and not so much in curriculum, about the pollution problem, how much Croats care about their health, what we should do with excess money, the boycott of stores, and the Pandemia. Nenad Bakic, entrepreneur and investor, mathematician by education, until his thirties, worked at the Mathematical Faculty in Zagreb, when he went to the world of entrepreneurship. Deals first of all finances, it is the first in Croatia to receive the prestigious Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA) title. He is best known as the MojPosao portal, who once transformed employment in Croatia. Founded other companies to which he still owns. As an investor, he promoted investment in shares of Croatian tourist companies. Jury member for the EY Entrepreneur of the Year. Together with his wife, the founder and financier of the Institute for Youth Development and Innovation, whose STEM program is Croatian Makers is the largest unrestrained educational program in the European Union. He was also a leading pandemic analyst in Croatia and the author of Mrcmo epidemic model, the only one in Croatia, and thanks to his pandemic engagement, Croatia avoided rigid measures of a multitude of countries. In its analyzes, the economy, demographics, health and other important topics are touched on ... / Romano Bolković - 1 na 1 - (talk show, Hrvatska, 2025) S gostom Nenadom Bakićem razgovarat ćemo o koncentriranju javnosti na Trumpa kao osobu, a ne političke procese koje pokreće, o razlozima i učincima ukidanja USAID-a i harangi protiv Elona Muska, o bojazni od oligarhije, Muska i njegova utjecaja, o položaju Europe i današnjoj europskoj AI industriji, o budućnosti električnih automobila, o demografskim projekcijama Hrvatske, o ukidanju fact-checkinga, o rezultatima robotičke lige i STEM opismenjavanja, o AI revoluciji, o tome zašto je problem u školstvu, a ne toliko u kurikulumu, o problemu onečišćenja, o tome koliko se Hrvati brinu o svom zdravlju, o tome što bismo trebali raditi s viškom novca, o bojkotu trgovina, te o rezimeu pandemije. Nenad Bakić, poduzetnik i ulagač, matematičar po obrazovanju, do svoje tridesete radio je na Matematičkom fakultetu u Zagrebu, kada se otisnuo u svijet poduzetništva. Baveći se ponajprije financijama, prvi je u Hrvatskoj koji je dobio prestižnu titulu Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA). Najpoznatiji je po portalu MojPosao, koji je svojedobno transformirao zapošljavanje u Hrvatskoj. Osnovao i druge kompanije kojima je i dalje vlasnik. Kao ulagač promovirao je ulaganje u dionice hrvatskih turističkih kompanija. Član žirija za EY poduzetnik godine. Zajedno sa suprugom osnivač je i financijer Instituta za razvoj i inovativnost mladih, čiji je STEM program Croatian Makers najveći nedržavni obrazovni program u Europskoj uniji. Također, bio je vodeći analitičar pandemije u Hrvatskoj te autor MRCMO epidemijskog modela, jedinog u Hrvatskoj, te je zahvaljujući njegovu angažmanu za pandemije Hrvatska izbjegla rigidne mjere mnoštva država. U svojim analizama dotiče se gospodarstva, demografije, zdravlja i drugih važnih tema...

programme.title: Minority mosaic / Manjinski mozaik
programme.desc: A minority mosaic - (educational film, Croatian) Paradise she dreamed of found in Croatia. When she is difficult and when she does not know what to do with the pain of the war in her native Ukraine, Oksana Hehedysh walks to the sea. He sent a prayer for peace to heaven and returned to the family home in Razanj near Rogoznica, where he lives for the last 8 years. Picture from childhood, today her art is an invitation to whom she surrendered with all her heart. With members of the Association for Ukrainian Culture in Dalmatia, "Cvit" organizes the arrivals of Ukrainian artists and their exhibitions in Croatia. It is also an opportunity for a kind of art-therapy that treats war wounds and gathering strength for some happier moments of inspiration ... / Manjinski mozaik - (obrazovni film, Hrvatska) Raj koji je sanjala pronašla je u Hrvatskoj. Kad joj je teško i kad ne zna što bi s boli zbog rata u rodnoj Ukrajini, Oksana Hehedysh prošeće do mora. Nebu uputi molitvu za mir i vrati se u obiteljski dom u mjestu Ražanj kraj Rogoznice, gdje živi posljednjih 8 godina. Slika od djetinjstva, danas joj je umjetnost poziv kojem se predala svim srcem. S članovima Udruge za ukrajinsku kulturu u Dalmaciji "Cvit" organizira dolaske ukrajinskih umjetnika i njihove izložbe u Hrvatskoj. To je i prilika za svojevrsnu art-terapiju kojom liječe ratne rane i skupljaju snagu za neke sretnije trenutke inspiracije...

programme.desc: In a quotation of a true story, (Philip Betoy) was a very popular French acrobatic player, allocating his life to walking on the wires, and since he saw the World Trade Center in the American capital (New York) when they were still in the construction phase, his greatest dream has become to walk between them at the top The impossible. / اقتباسًا عن قصة حقيقية، كان (فيليب بيتوي) لاعبًا أكروباتيًا فرنسيًا بالغ الشهرة، تخصص طيلة حياته في السير على الأسلاك، ومنذ أن رأى برجي مركز التجارة العالمي في العاصمة الأمريكية (نيويورك) حينما كانا لا يزالان في طور البناء، بات حلمه الأكبر أن يسير بينهما في أعلى القمة على سلك رفيع متصل بينهما، وهو ما يدفعه للتخطيط مع رفقائه من أجل تحقيق هذا الحلم لكي يتجاوز حدود المستحيل.

programme.title: He married what Lea said / تزوج ما قالها ليا
programme.desc: In a framework of comic events, a fifty widow man is in strange and funny situations when his three daughters are known for his second wife, claiming to be her aunt who was living in Italy. / في إطار من الأحداث الكوميدية، يقع رجل خمسيني أرمل في مواقف غريبة ومضحكة عندما يعرف بناته الثلاثة على زوجته الثانية مدعيا أنها خالتهن التي كانت تعيش في إيطاليا.

programme.title: middle age crisis / أزمة منتصف العمر
programme.desc: After Fayrouz marries Ezzat despite the great age difference between them, she falls in love with his daughter's husband - Omar - and their secret relationship causes many problems for her. / بعد أن تتزوج فيروز من عزت بالرغم من فارق السن الكبير بينهما، تقع في حب زوج ابنته- عمر - وتتسبب علاقتهما السرية بمشاكل كثيرة لها.

programme.title: Birth certificate / شهادة ميلاد
programme.desc: A mother is struggling with various means to preserve her family from disintegration, after the death of the father, but facts from the distant past are revealed to fluctuate the scales and fail all plans, and warns of a fateful future. / تجاهد أم بشتى الوسائل للحفاظ على عائلتها من التفكك وذلك بعد وفاة الأب، لكن حقائق من الماضي البعيد تتكشف لتقلب الموازين وتفشل كل الخطط، وتنذر بمستقبل مشؤوم.

programme.title: Woh toh hai albelaa / Woh Toh Hai Albelaa
programme.desc: (Krishna) is a fun brother who loves his brother and always stands beside them, especially his older brother (Chero), who is doing his best to maintain his safety and protect him from any harm, then his life turns upside down when circumstances force him to marry Habiba (Chero). / (كريشنا) هو أخ مرح محب لشقيقيه ويقف بجانبهما دائمًا، وبالأخص شقيقه الأكبر (تشيرو) الذي يبذل قصارى جهده للحفاظ على سلامته وحمايته من أي مكروه، ثم تنقلب حياته رأسًا على عقب عندما تجبره الظروف على الزواج من حبيبة (تشيرو).

programme.title: My mom / أمي
programme.desc: Basma lives in a house that is shrouded in violence and neglect because of her mother's husband, Obaid, who suffers from a smile of ill -treatment and lack of safety, which makes her life full of fear and loneliness. Her teacher, Maryam, hinted silent signs of Basma's suffering, so she decided to intervene to save her from this difficult situation. Mary creates a strong relationship with Basma, and fights alongside her to free her from the circle of pain and violence, which makes a major shift in the child's life and gives her hope for a better future. / تعيش الطفلة بسمة في منزل يكتنفه العنف والإهمال بسبب زوج والدتها عبيد، تعاني بسمة من سوء المعاملة وقلة الأمان، مما يجعل حياتها مليئة بالخوف والوحدة. تلمح معلمتها مريم، علامات صامتة على معاناة بسمة، فتقرر التدخل لإنقاذها من هذا الوضع الصعب. تنشئ مريم علاقة قوية مع بسمة، وتكافح إلى جانبها لتحريرها من دائرة الألم والعنف، مما يحدث تحولًا كبيرًا في حياة الطفلة ويمنحها الأمل في مستقبل أفضل.

Mary creates a strong relationship with Basma, and fights alongside her to free her from the circle of pain and violence, which makes a major shift in the child's life and gives her hope for a better future. / تعيش الطفلة بسمة في منزل يكتنفه العنف والإهمال بسبب زوج والدتها عبيد، تعاني بسمة من سوء المعاملة وقلة الأمان، مما يجعل حياتها مليئة بالخوف والوحدة. تلمح معلمتها مريم، علامات صامتة على معاناة بسمة، فتقرر التدخل لإنقاذها من هذا الوضع الصعب. تنشئ مريم علاقة قوية مع بسمة، وتكافح إلى جانبها لتحريرها من دائرة الألم والعنف، مما يحدث تحولًا كبيرًا في حياة الطفلة ويمنحها الأمل في مستقبل أفضل.

programme.title: Wild Heart S2 / Wild Heart S2
programme.desc: In the second season, after the meeting of all family members under one roof, (Yaman) reveals the real intentions (Sarhan), and faces a dangerous opponent, and he seeks to secure the future of his loved ones. / في الموسم الثاني وبعد اجتماع جميع أفراد العائلة تحت سقف واحد، يكشف (يامان) نوايا (سرحان) الحقيقية، ويواجه خصما خطيرا، فيسعى لتأمين مستقبل أحبائه.

programme.title: Birth certificate / شهادة ميلاد
programme.desc: A mother is struggling with various means to preserve her family from disintegration, after the death of the father, but facts from the distant past are revealed to fluctuate the scales and fail all plans, and warns of a fateful future. / تجاهد أم بشتى الوسائل للحفاظ على عائلتها من التفكك وذلك بعد وفاة الأب، لكن حقائق من الماضي البعيد تتكشف لتقلب الموازين وتفشل كل الخطط، وتنذر بمستقبل مشؤوم.

programme.title: Why not?! 3 / ليه لأ؟! 3
programme.desc: The events revolve around (Sherry), a divorced mother with a special relationship with her son (Yassin), but when she falls in love again, Yassin's jealousy forms an obstacle that they must overlook together. / تدور الأحداث حول (شيري)، وهي أم مطلقة تتمتع بعلاقة خاصة مع ابنها (ياسين)، ولكن عندما تقع في الحب من جديد، تشكل غيرة (ياسين) عليها عقبة يتوجب عليهما تجاوزها سويًا.

programme.title: My Name Is Farah / My Name Is Farah
programme.desc: Farah works illegally cleaning in Istanbul after escaping from Iran, then she tries to travel to France and take care of her young son, but her life turns upside down when she witnesses a murder in her workplace, then she tries to escape from the perpetrators of the crime after getting to know her. / تعمل (فرح) عاملة نظافة بشكل غير قانوني في إسطنبول بعد فرارها من إيران، ثم تحاول السفر إلى فرنسا والاعتناء بابنها الصغير، لكن تنقلب حياتها رأسًا على عقب عندما تشهد جريمة قتل في مكان عملها، ثم تحاول الهرب من مرتكبي الجريمة بعد تعرفهم عليها.

programme.title: He married what Lea said / تزوج ما قالها ليا
programme.desc: In a framework of comic events, a fifty widow man is in strange and funny situations when his three daughters are known for his second wife, claiming to be her aunt who was living in Italy. / في إطار من الأحداث الكوميدية، يقع رجل خمسيني أرمل في مواقف غريبة ومضحكة عندما يعرف بناته الثلاثة على زوجته الثانية مدعيا أنها خالتهن التي كانت تعيش في إيطاليا.

programme.title: middle age crisis / أزمة منتصف العمر
programme.desc: After Fayrouz marries Ezzat despite the great age difference between them, she falls in love with his daughter's husband - Omar - and their secret relationship causes many problems for her. / بعد أن تتزوج فيروز من عزت بالرغم من فارق السن الكبير بينهما، تقع في حب زوج ابنته- عمر - وتتسبب علاقتهما السرية بمشاكل كثيرة لها.

programme.title: Woh toh hai albelaa / Woh Toh Hai Albelaa
programme.desc: (Krishna) is a fun brother who loves his brother and always stands beside them, especially his older brother (Chero), who is doing his best to maintain his safety and protect him from any harm, then his life turns upside down when circumstances force him to marry Habiba (Chero). / (كريشنا) هو أخ مرح محب لشقيقيه ويقف بجانبهما دائمًا، وبالأخص شقيقه الأكبر (تشيرو) الذي يبذل قصارى جهده للحفاظ على سلامته وحمايته من أي مكروه، ثم تنقلب حياته رأسًا على عقب عندما تجبره الظروف على الزواج من حبيبة (تشيرو).

programme.title: Nun Al -Niswa / نون النسوة
programme.desc: In a social dramatic framework, the events of the series gathered five friends, gathering the paths of life, and their problems and dreams spread, and each of them tries to support the other until they reach safety after a group of disappointments that struck them. / في إطار درامي اجتماعي تجمع أحداث المسلسل خمس صديقات، تجمعهن دروب الحياة، فيتشاركن مشاكلهن، وأحلامهن، وتحاول كلا منهن مساندة الأخرى حتى يصلن إلى بر الأمان بعد مجموعة خيبات ضربت بهن.

programme.title: Pariersii / Parineetii
programme.desc: The events take place in a dramatic framework, where fate leads two friends close to marriage to the same man, which leads to many difficulties with the emergence of a complex love triangle, and the events continue. / تدور الأحداث في إطار درامي، حيث يقود القدر صديقتين مقربتين للزواج من نفس الرجل، مما يؤدي إلى العديد من الصعوبات مع ظهور مثلث حب معقد، وتتوالى الأحداث.

programme.title: Dunk / Dunk
programme.desc: The series revolves around a university, where the student Amal accuses her professor of harassing her, thus receiving support from all around her, but we discover that all of this is part of a plan that the student has orphaned to save her fiancé from great trouble. / تدور أحداث المسلسل في إحدى الجامعات، حيث تتهم الطالبة أمل أستاذها بالتحرش بها وبذلك تلقى الدعم من جميع من حولها، ولكن نكتشف أن كل هذا هو جزء من خطة قد دبرتها الطالبة لإنقاذ خطيبها من ورطة كبيرة.

programme.title: Prince / البرنس
programme.desc: Within the framework of social drama, the series revolves around the Prince's family, where Radwan Al -Prince, who shares many social family relations between him and his family, after the death of his parents, and finds himself responsible for everyone. / في إطار الدراما الاجتماعية تدور أحداث المسلسل حول عائلة البرنس، حيث رضوان البرنس الذي يتشارك في العديد من العلاقات الأسرية الاجتماعية بينه وبين عائلته، وذلك بعد وفاة والديه، ويجد نفسه متولي مسئولية الجميع.

programme.title: Layalina 80 / ليالينا ٨٠
programme.desc: The events revolve around the eighties of Hisham's life, who returns from work in the Gulf and his life changes after a car accident that his beautiful daughter is exposed to the driver, Radi, and begins to notice what he does not know about his wife, Maryam. / تدور الأحداث في الثمانينات حول حياة هشام، الذي يعود من العمل بالخليج وتتغير حياته بعد حادث سيارة تتعرض له ابنته جميلة مع السائق راضي، ويبدأ في ملاحظة ما لا يعلمه عن زوجته مريم.

programme.title: Break bond / كسر عضم
programme.desc: The ruling facilitates the illegal smuggling of its power and its many relationships by the corrupt policemen, despite his son, Ryan, the police officer who is tackling outlaws. / يقوم الحكم بتيسير عمليات التهريب الغير شرعية لسلطته وعلاقاته العديدة من قبل رجال الشرطة الفاسدين، على الرغم من ابنه ريان ضابط الشرطة الذي يقوم بالتصدي للخارجين عن القانون.

programme.title: My dear father / والدي العزيز
programme.desc: A failed love story ends with the separation of a man and a woman and their departure from each other, but when they meet again after many years, this love story returns to open its doors again. / تنتهي قصة حب فاشلة بانفصال رجل وامرأة وابتعادهما عن بعضهما البعض، ولكن حينما يتقابلان من جديد بعد سنوات عديدة، تعود قصة الحب تلك لتفتح أبوابها من جديد.

programme.title: Wild Bees / Wild Bees
programme.desc: In a framework of crime and drama, and after the death of their father, his three daughters must confront the richest man in their village who wants to buy their fields by force and by providing several temptations. / في إطار من الجريمة والدراما، وبعد وفاة والدهن، يتعين على بناته الثلاث مواجهة أغنى رجل في قريتهم الذي يريد شراء حقولهم بالقوة ومن خلال تقديم عدة مغريات.

programme.title: London batch / دفعة لندن
programme.desc: The story of a group of Arab students who move to the city of fog to study during the eighties, carrying their ideas, traditions and various dreams, to start tales of love, jealousy and conspiracies. / قصة مجموعة من الطلبة العرب الذين ينتقلون إلى مدينة الضباب للدراسة خلال فترة الثمانينيات حاملين معهم أفكارهم وتقاليدهم وأحلامهم المختلفة، لتبدأ حكايات الحب والغيرة والمؤامرات.

programme.title: Raisinghani vs raisinghani / Raisinghani vs Raisinghani
programme.desc: In a dramatic framework, the skilled smart lawyer (Anushka) works with her ambitious colleague (Firat), but their lives change after the appearance of the trainee (Ankita) who hides her true intention and hides under the guise of the researcher for a job opportunity. / في إطار درامي، تعمل المحامية الذكية الماهرة (أنوشكا) مع زميلها الطموح (فيرات)، ولكن تتغير حياتهما بعد ظهور المتدربة (أنكيتا) التي تخفي نيتها الحقيقية وتتخفى تحت ستار الباحثة عن فرصة عمل.

programme.title: Mawlana, the lover / مولانا العاشق
programme.desc: The events revolve around a young man named (Sultan) who works as a microbus driver, lives in a popular neighborhood and has a love relationship with a girl in the same popular neighborhood, but she does not exchange a feeling and prefers a wealthy young man, after which he is subjected to a group of problems he and his cousin (Shehata). / تدور الأحداث حول شاب يدعى(سلطان) يعمل سائق ميكروباص، ويقيم بحي شعبي وتربطه علاقة حب مع بنت في نفس الحي الشعبي ولكنها لا تبادله الشعور وتفضل عليه شاب ثري، ليتعرض بعدها لمجموعة من المشكلات هو وابن عمه (شحتة).

programme.title: My Name Is Farah / My Name Is Farah

programme.title: My mom / أمي
programme.desc: Basma lives in a house that is shrouded in violence and neglect because of her mother's husband, Obaid, who suffers from a smile of ill -treatment and lack of safety, which makes her life full of fear and loneliness. Her teacher, Maryam, hinted silent signs of Basma's suffering, so she decided to intervene to save her from this difficult situation. Mary creates a strong relationship with Basma, and fights alongside her to free her from the circle of pain and violence, which makes a major shift in the child's life and gives her hope for a better future. / تعيش الطفلة بسمة في منزل يكتنفه العنف والإهمال بسبب زوج والدتها عبيد، تعاني بسمة من سوء المعاملة وقلة الأمان، مما يجعل حياتها مليئة بالخوف والوحدة. تلمح معلمتها مريم، علامات صامتة على معاناة بسمة، فتقرر التدخل لإنقاذها من هذا الوضع الصعب. تنشئ مريم علاقة قوية مع بسمة، وتكافح إلى جانبها لتحريرها من دائرة الألم والعنف، مما يحدث تحولًا كبيرًا في حياة الطفلة ويمنحها الأمل في مستقبل أفضل.

programme.title: Hakim Pasha / حكيم باشا
programme.desc: (Hakim) works to excavate the effects and their trade, then his uncle puts all the family’s property in his hand due to his intelligence and support for him in managing his business, and thus becomes great for the family and governs control of their affairs, but soon his enemies, and conspiracies surrounded by every direction, even from the closest relatives. / يعمل (حكيم) في التنقيب عن الآثار وتجارتها، ثم يضع عمه كل أملاك العائلة في يده نظرًا لذكائه ومساندته له في إدارة أعماله، ويصبح بذلك كبيرًا للعائلة ويُحكم السيطرة على أمورها، لكن سرعان ما يكثر أعداؤه، وتحيط به المؤامرات من كل اتجاه، حتى من أقرب الأقربين.

programme.title: My sisters are my songs / خواتي غناتي
programme.desc: In a dramatic framework, three sisters find themselves under the control of their older sister after the death of their mother with mysterious circumstances, as their sister manipulates them to ensure the success of their marriage to wealthy men, and the events continue. / في إطار درامي، تجد ثلاث شقيقات أنفسهن تحت سيطرة أختهن الكبرى بعد وفاة والدتهن بظروف غامضة، حيث تتلاعب بهن أختهن لضمان نجاح زواجهن من رجال أثرياء، وتتوالى الأحداث.

programme.title: Forgetfulness / النسيان
programme.desc: The events revolve around a couple who live a happy life with their two sons, until an accident that turns their lives upside down, as their two sons are kidnapped and they try to search for them to reunite the family again. / تدور الأحداث حول زوجين يعيشان حياة سعيدة برفقة ولديهما، إلى حين وقوع حادث يقلب حياتهم رأسًا على عقب، حيث يُختطف ابنيهما فيحاولان البحث عنهما لإعادة لم شمل الأسرة من جديد.

programme.title: Selma / سلمى
programme.desc: The series deals with the story of Salma, a young mother who faces life alone after her husband, Jalal, disappeared in mysterious circumstances. She finds herself obliged to raise her two children in poverty, shocks and loneliness, embodying her journey a deep humanitarian model of the suffering of Arab mothers who are steadfastly having life. / يتناول المسلسل قصة سلمى، وهي أم شابة تواجه الحياة بمفردها بعد اختفاء زوجها جلال في ظروف غامضة. تجد نفسها مضطرة لتربية طفليها وسط الفقر والصدمات والوحدة، فتجسد رحلتها نموذجًا إنسانيًا عميقًا لمعاناة الأمهات العربيات اللواتي يواجهن قسوة الحياة بثبات.

programme.title: Good morning, Arabs / صباح الخير يا عرب
programme.desc: A daily morning program, discussing the social problems of interest to the Arab citizen, which displays many paragraphs such as motherhood, health, beauty, art, travel, and community problems. / برنامج صباحي يومي، يقوم بمناقشة المشاكل الإجتماعية التي تهم المواطن العربي، يعرض الكثير من الفقرات كالأمومة، والصحة، والجمال، والفن، والسفر، ومشاكل المجتمع.

programme.title: Studio 21 / ستوديو 21
programme.desc: In a social comic framework that tells about a satellite channel on the verge of bankruptcy, its dominant, authoritarian owner decides to continue the work, resulting in the occurrence of many comic paradoxes between him and the channel's employees. / في إطار اجتماعي كوميدي يحكي العمل عن قناة فضائية على وشك الإفلاس، يقرر مالكها المحتال المتسلط مواصلة العمل، مما ينتج عنه حدوث العديد من المفارقات الكوميدية بينه وبين العاملين بالقناة.

programme.title: Esref Ruya / Esref Ruya
programme.desc: In a romantic framework, the rich and reckless businessman (Ashraf) is in love with (Revelation), who was looking for a person like his life, but what is ignorant of him is that she is working against him for the police. / في إطار رومانسي، يقع رجل الأعمال الثري والمتهور (أشرف) في حب (رؤيا) التي كان يبحث عن شخصية مثلها طوال حياته، لكن ما يجهله هو أنها تعمل ضده لدى الشرطة.

The women spared the beginning of the century and were behind the killing of dozens, and the series shows the circumstances that led to the transformation of the two sisters Raya and Sakina into two criminals, reviewing the developments of their lives and their access to those around them, and the impact of the environment in which the two sisters grew up on their future. / قصة حياة الأختين (ريا) و(سكينة)، وهما من أشهر مجرمات القرن العشرين في مصر. روعتا النساء في مطلع القرن وكانتا وراء مقتل العشرات، ويعرض المسلسل الظروف التي أدت إلى تحول الأختين ريا وسكينة إلى مجرمتين مستعرضًا تطورات حياتهما وصلتهما بالمحيطين بهما، وتأثير البيئة التي نشأت فيها الأختان على مستقبلهما.

programme.title: Covenant / العهد
programme.desc: The events take place inside the Damascene neighborhood in two time periods separated by 15 years, during the period before the liberation of Damascus from the Ottoman occupation, and its hegemony period on the neighborhood, where a strong conflict between the elders and notables of the neighborhood is born to respond and resist it. / تدور الأحداث داخل حارة دمشقية في مرحلتين زمنيتين تفصل بينهما 15 سنة، خلال الفترة التي سبقت تحرير دمشق من الاحتلال العثماني، وفترة هيمنته على الحارة، حيث يولد نزاع قوي بين وجهاء وأعيان الحارة للرد عليه ومقاومته.

programme.title: Persia without permissibility / فارس بلا جواز

programme.title: House of distress / بيت الشدة
programme.desc: A granddaughter and magician's granddaughter called (astronomer) returning to her grandfather's house, in order to take revenge on those who burned the house in the past, in light of a curse chasing her son Saif, which is the domination of the spirit of the grandfather on his body, and she finds herself in the face of the confrontation of the people of Al -Hara led by (Mukhtar) and soon things develop. / حفيدة مشعوذ وساحر تُدعى (فَلك) تعود إلى منزل جدها، لأجل الانتقام مِن مَن حرقوا المنزل قديمًا، في ظل وجود لعنة تطارد ابنها سيف وهي سيطرة روح الجد على جسده، فتجد نفسها في مواجهة تصدي أهل الحارة لها بقيادة (مختار) وسرعان ما تتطور الأمور.

programme.title: Nose and three eyes / أنف وثلاث عيون
programme.desc: Egyptian drama deals with the story of a woman who admires a successful man in his work, even though she is married and establishes a relationship with him and after a while he tries to persuade her to return to her husband, but she refuses, one of his sick patients meets psychologically and suffers from her inability to move, he decides to marry her, but she surprises him that she has a relationship with a man who spends on her. / دراما مصرية تتناول قصة سيدة تُعجب برجل ناجح في عمله رغم أنها متزوجة وتقيم معه علاقة وبعد فترة يحاول ان يقنعها بالعودة لزوجها ولكنها ترفض، يلتقي إحدى مريضاته المريضة نفسيا وتعاني من عدم قدرتها على الحركة، يقرر الزواج منها ولكنها تفاجئه أن لها علاقة برجل يقوم بالإنفاق عليها.

programme.title: Diary and Nice C1 / يوميات ونيس ج1
programme.desc: Winis (Mohamed Sobhi) and his wife, Maysa (Souad Nasr), raising their four children on the good morals and values, and while performing this message, they discover that they disagree with many of the values ​​that they are trying to plant in their children, so they try to correct themselves. / يقوم ونيس (محمد صبحي) وزوجته مايسة (سعاد نصر) على تربية أبناءهما الأربعة على الأخلاق والقيم الصالحة، وأثناء تأديتهم لهذه الرسالة يكتشفان أنهما يخالفان الكثير من القيم التي يحاولنان زرعها في أولادهما، فيحاولان التصحيح من نفسيهما.

Sinbad adventures / مغامرات السندباد البحري

programme.title: A program in the homes of God / برنامج في بيوت الله
Omar bin Abdulaziz / عمر بن عبدالعزيز
programme.desc: The series deals with the biography of the fifth adult caliphs (Omar bin Abdul Aziz), starting from its upbringing as an Umayyad young man, and until its arrival in the chair of government, how he led the country and ruled it with righteousness and justice in the shadow of an era that was full of temptations and wars, and how it contributed to the spread of Islamic conquests in the world. / يتناول المسلسل السيرة الذاتية لخامس الخلفاء الراشدين (عمر بن عبد العزيز)، بداية من نشأته كشاب أموي، وحتى وصوله إلى كرسي الحكم، كيف قاد البلاد وحكمها بالصلاح والعدل في ظل عصر كان مليء بالفتن والحروب، وكيف ساهم في إنتشار الفتوحات اﻹسلامية في العالم.

programme.title: Justice has many faces / للعدالة وجوه كثيرة
programme.desc: (Jaber Mamoun Nassar) A famous businessman who has his reputation and his good reputation among people and lives with his wife and daughter a quiet life, tried to hide his truth throughout his life as an illegitimate child, but a murder occurred and is being investigated in it, revealing all the hidden past. / (جابر مأمون نصار) رجل أعمال مشهور و له صيته وسمعته الطيبة بين الناس ويعيش مع زوجته وابنته حياة هادئة، حاول إخفاء حقيقته طوال حياته كونه طفل غير شرعي، إلا أن جريمة قتل تحدث ويتم التحقيق معه فيها، تكشف كل الماضي المستور.

programme.desc: From 2021. Gargamel clones itself to catch all the hundreds of smurfs. But three garlamel is no good idea ... / Fra 2021. Gargamel kloner seg selv for å fange alle de hundre smurfene. Men tre Gargamel er ingen god ide ...

programme.desc: From 2011. Grandma pig is very pleased with the plastic niches and the wish well she has provided to the garden, but grandfather pig wants them to disappear. / Fra 2011. programme.desc: From 2020. A murder case becomes complicated when Victoria discovers the victim's many secrets. In prison, Victoria receives a scary warning. / Fra 2020. En drapssak blir komplisert når Victoria oppdager offerets mange hemmeligheter. I fengselet får Victoria en skremmende advarsel.

programme.title: Lifetime / Livstid
programme.desc: From 2020. A murder is committed during the recording of a popular reality series. Victoria is left to herself in prison. / Fra 2020. Et drap blir begått under opptak av en populær realityserie. Victoria blir overlatt til seg selv i fengselet.

Hvordan skal de ta valg for fremtiden, når krigens herjinger overskygger alt?
